item.title: 米陸軍、アイオワで劣化爆薬を「管理爆破処理」 有害物質検出されず
item.description:
Jim Urquhart Steve Gorman Renee Hickman
[ミドルタウン（米アイオワ州） ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jim Urquhart 　Steve Gorman　Renee Hickman

[ミドルタウン（米アイオワ州）　 ２５日 ロイター] - 米陸軍は２５日、中西部アイオワ州ミドルタウンの弾薬工場で、劣化により自然爆発の恐れがあった爆薬用の化合物「アジ化鉛」の爆破処理に無事成功したと発表した。有害な鉛粉じんの飛散を最小限に抑えることができたとしている。

ミドルタウンでは最寄りの住民が予防措置として事前に避難したほか、その他の住民には爆発で発生する可能性のある鉛粉じんにさらされるのを避けるため、自宅待機が求められた。

米陸軍と米環境保護局（ＥＰＡ）によると、爆破直後に実施した周辺地域の大気監視では、空気中の鉛は検出されなかった。ただ当局は、安全が確認されるまで屋内待機を続けるよう住民に呼び掛け、一部住民からは当局の説明に懐疑的な声も上がった。

今回の爆破処理を巡っては、処分計画の是非を巡る議論や法的対立が発生。当局は、劣化した化合物入り容器が自然に爆発する事態を待つよりも、今回の処理方法の方がはるかに安全だと説明していた。

米連邦緊急事態管理庁（ＦＥＭＡ）は米中部時間午前９時過ぎ、Ｘへの投稿で爆破処理の実施を確認し、周辺住民に引き続き屋内退避を続けるよう求めた。

その後、テル陸軍長官代行はＸに、劣化したプラスチック製ドラム缶６８本に保管されていた約４．５トンの高感度爆薬アジ化鉛を処分するための「管理・抑制下での爆破」が「期待を大きく上回る成功だった」と投稿するとともに、自然発生的な爆発の脅威は取り除かれたと強調した。

作業を指揮した爆発物専門家は「２次爆発はなく、破片の飛散はなかった。施設内外でインフラ被害もなかった。ミドルタウンと周辺地域の住民の健康と安全へのリスクを、人間に可能な限りゼロに近づけた」と語った。

住民の間では、爆発によって有毒な鉛粉じんが周辺の住宅や農地、家畜に降下することへの懸念が広がっていた。爆発現場となった弾薬工場は、州都デモインの南西約２４１キロに位置する。

item.description: ＜為替＞ 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、安全資産とされるスイスフランと日本円が上昇する一方、ドルが下落した。株式市場で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（25日）ドル下落、利回り低下　ナスダック・Ｓ＆Ｐ続落 7:03 配信

＜為替＞ 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、安全資産とされるスイスフランと日本円が上昇する一方、ドルが下落した。株式市場では人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄が急落し、波乱の一日となったが、株価はその後、序盤の下げ幅の大半を取り戻した。ＡＩ関連株への売りが再燃する中、ハイテク株比率の高いナスダック総合指数は、一時４％近く下落した後、下げ幅を約０．６％まで縮小した。こうした中、ドルは取引序盤にリスク回避の動きで買われたものの、取引終盤にかけて下落した。ドルは株価急落時に安全資産として機能してきたが、ＡＩ関連銘柄に関連した資本流入や成長期待にも左右される。 この日発表の経済指標では、１０月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．８％上昇し、９月の３．６％上昇から伸びが加速した。変動の大きい食品・エネルギーを除くコアＰＣＥ価格指数は前年比３．３％上昇し、２０２３年１１月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。これを受け、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２７年初めまで利上げを続けるとの観測が強まった。ＣＩＢＣキャピタル・マーケッツの為替戦略責任者サラ・イン氏は「より大きな問題は、ターミナルレート（利上げの最終到達点）がどこに落ち着くかだ」と述べた。一方、トランプ政権が提案した、日本、中国、欧州連合（ＥＵ）を含む１４の貿易相手国・地域への新たな関税措置に対する市場の反応は限定的だった。前出のイン氏は、関税は想定済みで市場への影響はなかったと指摘。「これは『解放の日』の第２弾ではない」と述べた。 主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２２％安の１０３．６２。ユーロは０．１７％高の１ユーロ＝１．０９８３ドルとなった。円は対ドルで０．０６％高の１ドル＝１５９．１３円。ドルは対スイスフランでは０．６３％安の０．８３フランとなった。暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは０．３３％高の６万００５０ドル。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが低下したものの、朝方に付けた水準からは下げ幅を縮小した。米株式市場でＡＩ関連株が大幅安となったものの、売りの勢いが次第に弱まったことで、安全資産と見なされる米国債の需要を押し上げる効果が薄れた。米政権が朝方、「構造的な過剰生産能力」への対抗措置として日本、中国、ＥＵを含む１４の貿易相手国・地域に対する新たな関税措置を提案したが、債券市場は大きく反応しなかった。この日の米国株式市場は、午前の取引で急落した後に買い戻しの動きが広がり、午後の取引にかけて持ち直した。ハイテク銘柄の多いナスダック総合指数は一時４．７％安まで下げたが、その後は０．７％安まで値を戻した。ノーススター・マーケット・アナリシス（セントルイス）の市場ストラテジスト、スコット・レン氏は「相場がこれほど急速に下落すると、誰もが多少は神経質になる」と述べた。米国債利回りについては「１０年債利回りは４．８０％を大幅に下回る可能性は低い」と予想。年末に向けて不確実性が高い状況は続くと予想されるため、利回りを多少押し下げる要因になるとみられるものの、現在の経済環境や向こう１年から１年３カ月の間に起こり得る展開を踏まえると、利回りが大きく低下することはないとの見方を示した。ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、１２月８─９日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定される確率は９６．４％。ＦＲＢは９月のＦＯＭＣで０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定したが、中間選挙目前の１０月のＦＯＭＣではフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を３．７５－４．００％に据え置くと決定した。１０年債利回りは６．２ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．８４％。一時は４．８０％と、９月９日以来の低水準を付けた。３０年債利回りは６．６ｂｐ低下の５．２２７％。一時は５．２０６％まで低下し、８月３１日以来の低水準を付けた。２年債利回りは３．８ｂｐ低下の４．６３３％。一時は４．５７８％と、１１月１０日以来の低水準を付けた。２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は２０．５ｂｐ。一時１９．９ｂｐと、約２カ月ぶりの水準に縮小した。米金融市場は２６日は感謝祭（サンクスギビングデー）の祝日のため休場となる。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ ハイテク株が売られ、ナスダック総合とＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種が続落した。ただ、感謝祭の休暇を前に押し目買いが入り、一時の安値から下げ幅を大きく縮小して取引を終えた。ダウ工業株３０種は続伸した。ＡＩ関連株の売りや米国の新たな関税案を受けて投資家心理が悪化し、ナスダックは序盤に４％超下落する場面があった。ウェルスパイア・アドバイザーズのシニアバイスプレジデント兼アドバイザー、オリバー・パーシェ氏は「逆風となり得る要因は多数あるが、同時に『押し目買い』という条件付けもある程度あり、それが今の動きの一因になっている」と指摘。「全面安になると優良な銘柄まで一緒に売られがちだ。投資家はそうした価格のゆがみを捉えて買いを入れている」と語った。Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の業種別では情報技術が下げを主導した一方、素材や不動産などが上昇した。 ハイテク株への売りが深まる中、半導体大手エヌビディアが下げ、フィラデルフィア半導体指数も下落した。ナスダック１００指数は序盤に終値ベースの過去最高値からの下落率が２０％となり、弱気相場入りの目安とされる水準に達する場面があった。経済指標では、第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）改定値が４．３％増と、速報値の３．４％増から大幅に上方修正され、３年ぶりの高い伸びとなった。また、１０月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．８％上昇し、９月の３．６％上昇から伸びが加速した。これを受け、ＦＲＢが１２月に加え、２０２７年初めにも利上げするとの見方が強まった。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ １０月の米インフレ指標が強い内容となったものの、ＦＲＢの利上げ方針への懸念が根強く、金現物は一時１年超ぶりの安値を付けた。

金先物１２月限の清算値（終値に相当）は、前日比２６．１０ドル （０．７３％）安の１オンス＝３５３５．８０ドル。

１０月の米個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前月比０．３％上昇し、９月の０．５％から伸びが鈍化した。ハイリッジ・フューチャーズのデビッド・メーガー氏は「インフレ圧力がＦＲＢの目標を大きく上回る中、今後も利上げが続く可能性が高く、金相場の重しとなっている」と指摘した。市場では１２月のＦＲＢ会合での利上げが織り込まれている。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 北海ブレントが３％超、米ＷＴＩが２％上昇した。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビア最大のラス・タヌラ製油所を攻撃したと表明したことで、中東産原油の供給混乱への懸念が高まっている。清算値は北海ブレント先物が３．２１ドル（３．５％）高の１バレル＝９４．６１ドル、米ＷＴＩ先物が１．６３ドル（２．０％）高の８３．６８ドル。両先物は前日は２％超上昇していた。ラス・タヌラ製油所の精製能力は日量５５万バレル。ペルシャ湾沿岸にある主要輸出ターミナル付きの複合施設の一部で、過去にも攻撃対象になっていた。ＰＶＭの石油アナリスト、タマス・バルガ氏は、フーシ派の表明を受け地政学リスク・プレミアムが上昇し、原油高につながったと指摘。２６日の米国の感謝祭（サンクスギビングデー）の祝日を前に、売り持ち（ショートポジション）の買い戻しが進んだ可能性もあると述べた。プライス・フューチャーズ・グループのアナリスト、フィル・フリン氏も、市場では週末を控え地政学的緊張の高まりが警戒されているとしている。この日はこのほか、イランの革命防衛隊がイラン国営メディアに対し、原油輸送の要衝ホルムズ海峡でコンテナ船１隻が２４日に「無許可」の航路を航行していた際に標的となり、航行を停止したと明らかにした。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: イスラエル野党、ハマス奇襲巡る調査委設置へ前進 ネタニヤフ首相反対も
item.description:
[エルサレム ２５日 ロイター] - イスラエルの野党主導の議会は２５日、２０２３年１０月７日のイスラム組織ハマスによる攻撃を巡る独立調査委員会設置に向けた最初の採決で承認を与えた。同調査は、ネタニヤフ首相が反対する一方、首相の失脚を狙う野党勢力が公約として掲げてきた。
２５日の採決は、ハマスによる奇襲に至るまでのイスラエルの失策を調査する国家調査委員会の設置法案の可決に必要な４回の採決のうち最初のものとなる。
議会はまた、首相の任期を制限し、刑事訴追中の在任を禁じる法案も可決した。これらの措置は、イスラエル史上最長の在任期間を誇りながらも、汚職で起訴され、その容疑を否認するネタニヤフ氏を狙ったものとみられる。
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[エルサレム ２５日 ロイター] - イスラエルの野党主導の議会は２５日、２０２３年１０月７日のイスラム組織ハマスによる攻撃を巡る独立調査委員会設置に向けた最初の採決で承認を与えた。同調査は、ネタニヤフ首相が反対する一方、首相の失脚を狙う野党勢力が公約として掲げてきた。

２５日の採決は、ハマスによる奇襲に至るまでのイスラエルの失策を調査する国家調査委員会の設置法案の可決に必要な４回の採決のうち最初のものとなる。

議会はまた、首相の任期を制限し、刑事訴追中の在任を禁じる法案も可決した。これらの措置は、イスラエル史上最長の在任期間を誇りながらも、汚職で起訴され、その容疑を否認するネタニヤフ氏を狙ったものとみられる。

ネタニヤフ氏は、先月の総選挙で与党連合が議会の過半数を失った後、暫定首相として職務を継続している。

ネタニヤフ氏はテレビ演説で、この法案は「政治的排除のための道具」であり、イランや複数の独裁国家で用いられているものだと主張。「民主主義国家にはそのようなものは存在しない」と述べた。

item.title: Global stocks are mixed as AI shares tumble after a retreat on Wall Street
item.description: World stocks were mixed on Wednesday after a wave of heavy selling of stocks linked to artificial intelligence once again hit Wall Street.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
item.content:encoded: NEW YORK — Stocks on Wall Street closed moderately lower Wednesday after another punishing pullback in AI stocks lost momentum as the day went on, reversing much of the market’s losses. The S&P 500 index fell 0.3 per cent after having been down as much as 3.2 per cent earlier in the day. The Nasdaq composite finished 0.6 per cent lower. At one point, it had been down as much as 4.6 per cent. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.3 per cent. The market pared its losses even as a report raised more worries about high inflation and as President Donald Trump plans to escalate the U.S. trade war with major trading partners. AI stocks lost ground for a second day following Monday’s relief rally over the surprise reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia’s CEO. Stocks have been generally falling since setting an all-time high last month as worries grow that AI stock prices have grown unjustifiably high. The market turnaround came as some of the biggest tech companies bounced back from steep drops. Nvidia, which was down more than nine per cent at one point, closed with a 3.9 per cent loss. Broadcom, which had dropped more than six per cent, ended just 0.1 per cent lower, while Microsoft came back from a more than 3 per cent slide to finish down 1.2 per cent. There were some gainers among tech stocks: Meta climbed 3.4 per cent and Salesforce rose 2 per cent. Gains in financial services stocks also helped temper the market’s losses. Visa rose 1.8 per cent, Mastercard gained 1.9 per cent and American Express rose 1.2 per cent. Anthropic bounced back from an early drop to close with a 1.1 per cent gain. Still, since soaring to US$115 per share on the day it became the first major frontier lab to go public, Anthropic shares have tumbled by about 28 per cent. Roughly three quarters of the stocks in the S&P 500 rose, although the pullback in technology stocks kept the index in the red. Technology companies, particularly those focused on AI, have large market values that give them a dominant influence over whether major indexes rise or fall. Nvidia is among the most valuable companies on Wall Street and its surge on Monday led a tech sector rally. It is now one of the biggest weights pushing the market lower. The S&P 500 index is down 5.2 per cent for November, after losing some ground in October and September. “At this point, between the AI angst and the newly announced tariffs, it doesn’t look like the Santa Claus Rally is in store for us this year,” said Chris Zaccarelli, chief investment officer for Northlight Asset Management, in a research note. Questions about Nvidia’s corporate governance, as well as the influence of a U.S. president who owns millions of dollars’ worth of shares in the company, have added to concerns surrounding the artificial intelligence sector. Relief over Huang’s return as CEO is fading because of worries that AI might not produce enough profit to justify the large investments and stock values. That dynamic is running up against stubbornly high inflation. The latest update on inflation showed that prices rose at a more aggressive 3.8 per cent rate in October from the same period last year, and followed a 3.6 per cent rate in September. The data is from the Federal Reserve’s preferred measure of inflation, the personal consumption expenditures price index. Aside from potentially stifling economic growth, high inflation could mean higher interest rates, with the Fed likely to raise its benchmark interest rate at its December policy meeting to try to tame inflation. The rate of inflation is well above the central bank’s target of 2 per cent. The economy has been resilient, though, even as inflation squeezes households and businesses and consumers grow increasingly anxious about spending and finances. The government said that the economy grew even faster in the July-September quarter than previously estimated, with growth revised upward to a 4.3 per cent annual rate, the fastest in three years. Much of the spending that is driving the economy, though, has been from large tech firms building out AI infrastructure and from upper-income households. There are signs poorer Americans are relying more on credit to sustain their spending. Higher oil prices, fueled by the U.S. war with Iran and its impact on the world’s oil supply, have also contributed to inflation. The price of a barrel of Brent crude, the international standard, rose 3.5 per cent to settle at US$94.61 on Wednesday. The price has swung between US$72 and US$114 since the United States and Israel attacked Iran in February. Energy companies mostly gained ground Wednesday, including a 1.1 per cent rise for Chevron. The wide-ranging and often uncertain U.S. trade conflict with much of the world also added to rising costs. The U.S. plans to hike tariffs on China, the European Union and other trading partners after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down broader tariffs that were set last year. Businesses tend to pass along some or all of the cost of tariffs to consumers. Anger over stubbornly high prices was a factor in pushing voters to punish Republicans by handing majorities in the House and the Senate to Democrats. Treasury yields fell in the bond market. The yield on the 10-year Treasury fell to 4.87 per cent from 4.91 per cent late Tuesday. Markets fell throughout Europe and Asia. South Korea’s Kospi lost 6.2 per cent as Samsung Electronics fell 9.9 per cent and SK Hynix plummeted 11.1 per cent. Japan’s Nikkei 225 dropped 2.8 per cent. OpenAI investor SoftBank Group slumped 14.8 per cent. U.S. financial markets will be closed Thursday for Thanksgiving. On Friday, the stock market will close at 1:00 p.m. Eastern, and the bond market will close at 2:00 p.m. Eastern. ___ Damian J. Troise and Alex Veiga, The Associated Press Business reporter Elaine Lai and economics writer Christopher Rugaber contributed to this report.

item.title: ¿Es mejor esperar y comprar el iPhone Duo de segunda generación? Le explicamos
item.description: Con el iPhone Duo agotado hasta el próximo año y la segunda generación prevista en septiembre, esperar puede traer una pantalla y un hardware más maduros.
item.dc:creator: Julieth Barbosa
item.content:encoded: Con el primer plegable de Apple prácticamente sin unidades hasta el año que viene y el iPhone Duo 2 en el radar de septiembre, esperar no solo evita las listas de espera: también permite apuntar a un modelo más pulido en pantalla y hardware. El estreno comercial del iPhone Duo ha superado el examen inicial sin contratiempos graves, salvo por ciertos detalles puntuales en su panel. Aun así, el escenario actual reúne dos condicionantes que pesan en cualquier decisión de compra: inventario muy limitado hasta el próximo año y un margen de mejora amplio frente a lo que ofrece esta primera entrega. En los iPhone tradicionales, la evolución anual suele ser predecible: un año toma protagonismo la cámara y al siguiente la pantalla o el chip, sobre una fórmula ya muy asentada. En un plegable, en cambio, la categoría acaba de arrancar y las concesiones son visibles desde el primer momento. Mientras que en la gama tradicional Apple reparte pedidos entre múltiples proveedores, fabricar pantallas plegables a gran escala concentra el peso en muy pocas manos. Según filtraciones del informante chino Instant Digital, Samsung Display podría mantenerse como el único proveedor de pantallas plegables del iPhone Duo durante al menos cinco años. La firma compite con Apple en el mercado de los plegables, pero resulta indispensable en su fábrica por tres razones: Frente a ese panorama, LG Display lo tendría cuesta arriba para entrar en la cadena de suministro del Duo. Conseguir que una pantalla plegable aguante años de uso continuo sigue siendo uno de los mayores retos técnicos de la telefonía actual. Instant Digital había señalado previamente que Samsung cerró con Apple un acuerdo de exclusividad de tres años que cubriría el iPhone Duo y futuros modelos. Sin embargo, la filtración más reciente sugiere que, al cumplirse ese plazo, podría seguir sin haber otro fabricante listo para competir en igualdad de condiciones. Que un contrato de exclusividad tenga fecha de vencimiento no significa que Apple recupere margen de maniobra si ningún otro proveedor domina la fabricación al mismo nivel. Si Samsung conserva su ventaja técnica y productiva, Apple seguirá necesitando sus paneles incluso después de que expire ese acuerdo inicial. La situación trae a la memoria lo sucedido en 2017 con el lanzamiento del iPhone X y su paso a las pantallas OLED. Entonces, Samsung era el único fabricante capaz de aportar el volumen necesario, y aunque Apple respaldó a LG para sumar una segunda fuente, el relevo resultó complejo: en abril de 2018 aún persistían dudas sobre si LG podría suministrar paneles OLED para los iPhone de ese año. Si aquella incorporación ya costó en pantallas OLED, un terreno en el que LG siempre ha sido un referente, la dificultad es mayor en los plegables, un segmento en el que LG ni siquiera fabrica teléfonos inteligentes hoy en día. Las previsiones apuntan a que el iPhone Duo 2 llegará en septiembre del próximo año con pantalla de Samsung, al igual que el iPhone Duo 3. Queda por ver si LG logrará llegar a tiempo para una cuarta generación o si la rivalidad más emblemática de Apple seguirá sosteniendo cada nuevo plegable. Para quien no tenga prisa y busque un panel más resistente y una segunda generación más madura, esperar tiene argumentos claros. Vea más: Apple cae tras presentar el iPhone Duo: qué explica la reacción de Wall Street y qué viene ahora

item.title: 100周年のＮＹメーシーズ感謝祭パレード、28日に延期 悪天候予報で
item.description:
Kanishka Singh Jasper Ward
[２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kanishka Singh　Jasper Ward

[２５日 ロイター] - 米ニューヨーク市で２６日に開催される予定だった百貨店メーシーズの感謝祭パレードが、悪天候の予報を受けて２８日に延期されることになった。複数の米メディアが報じた。

メーシーズの感謝祭パレードは今年で１００回目を迎える。ＣＢＳニュースによると、同パレードは第２次世界大戦中の１９４２─４４年には中止されたものの、天候を理由に延期されるのは初めてという。

メーシーズは声明で、「参加者や観客の安全を最優先に考え、市や関係機関と綿密に協議した結果、今年のパレードの延期を決定した」と明らかにした。

ニューヨーク市のマムダニ市長事務所の当局者も、延期を確認した。

米国立気象局（NWS）は２６━２７日にかけて、ニューヨーク市に強風警報と沿岸洪水警報を発令している。

item.title: Miss Universo 2026: cuánto costaría el vestido de Luis Antonio con el que Jennifer Barreto ganó
item.description: Barreto hizo historia en el certamen en el que se coronó con un vestido que rinde tributo a otras reinas de belleza de Puerto Rico.
item.dc:creator: Isaac Garrido
item.content:encoded: La puertorriqueña Jennifer Barreto se convirtió en la nueva Miss Universo 2026 e hizo historia la noche del martes al ser la primera participante casada y madre en ganar el certamen. El concursó celebró 75 años en esta edición. Barreto, de 27 años, es la sucesora de la mexicana Fátima Bosch y su triunfo le devolvió el reinado a Puerto Rico tras 20 años. Precisamente, la nueva reina de belleza se coronó luciendo un vestido de noche cuyo diseño rindió tributo a las otras misses puertorriqueñas: Marisol Malaret (1970), Deborah Carthy-Deu (1985), Dayanara Torres (1993), Denise Quiñones (2001) y Zuleyka Rivera. El modelo tipo halter, realizado con pedrería, fue concebido por el diseñador Luis Antonio, cuyas creaciones alcanzan precios de hasta US$6.000 en su sitio oficial. Otros de aplicaciones de pedrería se ofrecen por US$4.900. La página de Luis Antonio incluye otros vestidos de noche que llegan a oscilar entre US$1.500 y US$2.000. Sin embargo, especialistas señalan que un traje de noche para Miss Universo puede llegar a superar por mucho ese precio. Por ejemplo, el maquillador Byron Villamar, señaló a Ecuavisa que un vestido suele costar entre US$6.000 y US$7.000. Por su parte, el diseñador Steven Vera declaró a ese medio que el traje para una final promedia entre USD$3.000 y USD$4.000 Los altos costos de un vestido suelen responder tanto al nombre del diseñador como a las exigencias de su diseño. En el caso del vestido de Jennifer Barreto en Miss Universo 2026 , implicó una elaboración entre Puerto Rico, India y Nueva York. En la isla sede del certamen se creó el patrón y posteriormente viajó a Nueva York, donde fue digitalizado y se elaboró el patrón en tela, ajustado exactamente a su figura, según Primera Hora. Posteriormente, la prenda se envió a la India, donde artesanos bordaron a mano los canutillos blancos, plateados y transparentes que definieron el patrón de líneas del vestido. Finalmente, la pieza regresó a Puerto Rico donde se completó la confección final a mano de la prenda que se presentó con una larga capa de plumas.

item.description: Israeli judges have recommended dropping one of three corruption cases against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and reconsidering another, in a trial that began in 2020.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Israeli judges recommend prosecutors drop one bribery case against Netanyahu

Israeli judges have recommended dropping one of three corruption cases against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and reconsidering another, in a trial that began in 2020.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrives to speak to the media at the Knesset, Israel's parliament in Jerusalem, Nov 25, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Ronen Zvulun)

FAST

JERUSALEM: Israeli judges on Wednesday (Nov 25) recommended that prosecutors drop one of three long-running cases against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and reconsider another alleging he granted favours in exchange for positive media coverage. Netanyahu was indicted in 2019 on charges of bribery, fraud and breach of trust. He denies the charges and has pleaded not guilty. His trial began in 2020 and involves three criminal cases. In the case referred to as Case 4000, prosecutors allege that Netanyahu granted regulatory favours worth around 1.8 billion shekels (about US$500 million) to Bezeq Telecom Israel. In return, prosecutors say, he sought positive coverage for himself and his wife, Sara, on a news website controlled by former Bezeq Chairman Shaul Elovitch. Elovitch has denied wrongdoing. In a blow to prosecutors, Judge Rivka Friedman-Feldman of Jerusalem District Court , who presides over Case 4000, told Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara at a hearing on Wednesday that a conviction was unlikely and the case should be dropped.

The recommendation was not a ruling on the case, the court clarified, and Baharav-Miara said she would review the court's statements with the prosecution. The judges also recommended prosecutors reconsider so-called Case 2000 because of doubts that Netanyahu's actions constituted a criminal offence. In that case, prosecutors allege Netanyahu negotiated a deal with Arnon Mozes, owner of Israel's Yedioth Ahronoth newspaper, for better coverage in return for legislation to slow the growth of a rival newspaper. Netanyahu on Wednesday called the court's recommendation a "ray of light for truth and justice." "Ten years of suffering for dozens of my close ones who were dragged into interrogation rooms," Netanyahu said in a televised address. "Where they were blackmailed with criminal acts, humiliated, and the lives of many of them were ruined, just so they would give false testimony against me."

item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝ナスダック・Ｓ＆Ｐ続落、押し目買いで下げ幅は縮小 6:22 配信

米ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）で11月25日撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） ［２５日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場ではハイテク株が売られ、ナスダック総合とＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種が続落した。ただ、感謝祭の休暇を前に押し目買いが入り、一時の安値から下げ幅を大きく縮小して取引を終えた。ダウ工業株３０種は続伸した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の売りや米国の新たな関税案を受けて投資家心理が悪化し、ナスダックは序盤に４％超下落する場面があった。

ウェルスパイア・アドバイザーズのシニアバイスプレジデント兼アドバイザー、オリバー・パーシェ氏は「逆風となり得る要因は多数あるが、同時に『押し目買い』という条件付けもある程度あり、それが今の動きの一因になっている」と指摘。「全面安になると優良な銘柄まで一緒に売られがちだ。投資家はそうした価格のゆがみを捉えて買いを入れている」と語った。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の業種別では情報技術が下げを主導した一方、素材や不動産などが上昇した。

ハイテク株への売りが深まる中、半導体大手エヌビディアが下げ、フィラデルフィア半導体指数も下落した。

ナスダック１００指数は序盤に終値ベースの過去最高値からの下落率が２０％となり、弱気相場入りの目安とされる水準に達する場面があった。

トランプ米大統領は２５日、日本、中国、欧州連合（ＥＵ）を含む１４の貿易相手国・地域に対し、新たな関税措置を提案した。「構造的な過剰生産能力」への対抗措置だとしており、世界的な貿易摩擦が再燃する恐れがある。

経済指標では、第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）改定値が４．３％増と、速報値の３．４％増から大幅に上方修正され、３年ぶりの高い伸びとなった。また、１０月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．８％上昇し、９月の３．６％上昇から伸びが加速した。

これを受け、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１２月に加え、２０２７年初めにも利上げするとの見方が強まった。

item.title: Caputo detalló cómo pagará Argentina los próximos vencimientos y dijo que pidió a China uso del swap
item.description: “No creo que el mercado dude de ningún pago, ni del de enero ni del de julio”, dijo Caputo en una entrevista, en la que detalló de dónde saldrán los dólares para el pago por US$4.400 millones que el p ...
item.dc:creator: Tomás Carrió
item.content:encoded: Buenos Aires — Luis Caputo detalló cómo hará Argentina para pagar los próximos vencimientos de deuda y descartó que el mercado tenga dudas respecto de la voluntad o capacidad de pago del gobierno de Javier Milei . Al brindar este miércoles una entrevista a la señal de streaming Neura, el ministro de Economía argentino precisó de dónde saldrán los dólares para afrontar el pago por casi US$4.400 millones a bonistas de enero. Además, dijo que solicitó a China el uso del tramo activo del swap de divisas, por unos US$5.000 millones, para dar mayor certidumbre a inversores respecto de las fuentes de fondeo para cerrar el programa financiero. VER MÁS: Dólar, riesgo país y recesión: qué dijo Luis Caputo sobre el rumbo de la economía “No creo que el mercado dude de ningún pago, ni del de enero ni del de julio”, sostuvo el titular del Palacio de Hacienda al recordar la tasa que reflejan los instrumentos de deuda que vencen dentro de la actual gestión. En cambio, marcó que “el gran salto” se observa de los bonos del 2028 en adelante. “Ahí es donde el riesgo país se dispara y las tasas se duplican”, expresó. Ese spread de tasas, a ojos de Caputo, se explica por “el temor del mercado de que no esté Javier Milei”. Y si bien reiteró que a su juicio se trata de un temor infundado, reconoció que “hay gente que lo tiene”. “El temor es a que Argentina se desvíe del curso por la eventualidad que el presidente Milei no gane las elecciones”, añadió. VER MÁS: Riesgo país argentino en 800 puntos hace retocar el programa financiero con más compras al BCRA Respecto del pago de enero, Caputo detalló que Argentina debe pagar US$4.370 millones. Para hacer frente a ese compromiso, precisó que en las próximas semanas estarán entrando unos US$1.200 millones del Fondo Monetario Internacional, por la aprobación de la tercera revisión del programa, y otros organismos multilaterales. A ello, añadió que también ingresarán los US$1.000 millones pendientes de financiamientos garantizados con CAF y Fonplata, y unos US$300 millones por la privatización de AySA. Esos US$2.500 millones a US$2.600 millones, dijo Caputo, le permitirán al país afrontar los vencimientos de capital. Para los intereses, añadió, el Tesoro le comprará al BCRA los US$1.800 millones restantes con pesos del superávit. “No cambió nada en el programa financiero”, aseguró. VER MÁS: El FMI alcanza acuerdo a nivel técnico con Argentina sobre la tercera revisión del programa Al referirse al programa financiero de 2027, Caputo también confió en que para octubre próximo “ya va a estar claro que el presidente Milei va a reelegir”, lo que hará que el refinanciamiento de los bonos en ese tramo “sea mucho más fácil”. No obstante, dijo que en el equipo económico siempre trabajan “con la premisa de estar equivocados”, por lo que, como reaseguro, aseguró que “ya le pedimos a China los US$5.000 millones del swap que están ya disponibles, ya están aprobados”. “Lo que le estamos pidiendo directamente es fondeémoslo , para dar la mayor certidumbre posible. Yo creo que va a haber refinanciamiento. ¿El mercado piensa que no? Bueno, nuestra tarea es darle certidumbre. Entonces, le pedimos a China, ponemos los US$5.000 millones ahí, se los compra el Tesoro, y ya los tienen ahí, están todos los pagos garantizados y listo”, dijo.

item.title: Precio de las boletas de cine en Colombia subiría a COP$18.088 con el IVA de la reforma tributaria
item.description: La reforma tributaria quitaría la exclusión de IVA a las boletas desde 2028. Según Proimágenes, la asistencia caería casi a la mitad y la taquilla, 37,5 %.
item.dc:creator: Oscar Barrero
item.content:encoded: Bogotá — El precio de las entradas de cine en Colombia podría aumentar a partir de 2028 si prospera la propuesta incluida en el Proyecto de Rescate Económico, que contempla aplicar una tarifa de IVA del 19% a la boletería. La medida tendría efectos sobre la asistencia a las salas, los ingresos de la industria y la generación de empleo en el sector. De acuerdo con un análisis de Proimágenes, la aplicación de este impuesto reduciría considerablemente la asistencia de espectadores y pondría en riesgo miles de puestos de trabajo en el territorio nacional. Uno de los principales efectos se reflejaría en el precio de las entradas. Según las estimaciones de la entidad, el valor promedio de una boleta pasaría de COP$15.200 a COP$18.088 en 2028. Este aumento también tendría consecuencias sobre los ingresos de taquilla. Proimágenes calcula que estos caerían 37,5%, al pasar de COP$811.680 millones a COP$507.549 millones. En términos de asistencia, el sector dejaría de vender 25,3 millones menos, la diferencia entre 53,4 y 28,1 millones frente al escenario proyectado sin la aplicación de la medida. Ver más: Cine colombiano necesita conquistar una audiencia que le ha sido esquiva Por su parte, el recaudo tributario estimado por esta propuesta del Gobierno De la Espriella alcanzaría los COP$96.434 millones en 2028. Sin embargo, el consumo de alimentos y bebidas en las salas también se reduciría, pues sus ingresos pasarían de COP$170.880 millones a COP$89.792 millones. Asimismo, el ingreso neto sería COP$15.346 millones que no corresponden a ingresos adicionales para el sector cinematográfico, sino al beneficio neto que obtendría el Estado. Esta cifra se da debido a los COP$96.434 millones que recaudaría por concepto del IVA el monto que dejaría de percibir por el impuesto al consumo del 8 % aplicado a los alimentos y bebidas vendidos en las salas de cine. El impacto sobre la cantidad de espectadores sería uno de los principales efectos de la iniciativa. Proimágenes estima que la asistencia a las salas de cine disminuiría 47,4% en 2028, hasta ubicarse en 28,1 millones de espectadores. La cifra contrasta con los 53,4 millones de asistentes contemplados en el escenario de referencia, lo que evidencia la magnitud de la reducción que podría experimentar la industria si se implementa el cobro del IVA del 19% a las entradas. El empleo también estaría entre los rubros afectados. Según el análisis, se perderían 1.640 puestos de trabajo directos y 1.293 a indirectos. En el sector de exhibición cinematográfica estarían en riesgo 2.800 empleos. Esta cifra hace parte de un total aproximado de 5.800 puestos de trabajo que, según las estimaciones del sector, podrían verse afectados. Las proyecciones indican que el número de salas de cine podría pasar de las 1.260 actualmente activas a 687, lo que supondría una disminución de 573 espacios de exhibición.

LONDON, Nov 25 : WBO heavyweight champion Daniel Dubois will make the second defence of his belt against former holder Joseph Parker in Manchester on January 30, promoter Frank Warren said on Wednesday. The 'New Year's Retribution' fight will be shown live on DAZN. The pair were originally scheduled to meet in February last year, when Dubois was IBF champion, but the Briton pulled out due to illness. Parker, who held the WBO title from 2016 to 2018, was suspended after failing a dope test in October 2025 but was cleared to return to the ring last August.

Dubois has won 24 of his 27 professional fights while Parker has a 36-4 record. "It's a fight everyone wanted to see and I'm thrilled we can now make it happen," said Warren on the Queensberry website. "Daniel is entering his prime and when he is on his game it is hard to picture anybody beating him. But Joseph has long promised to become world champion again and now he gets his chance." Dubois made his first defence of the WBO belt with a one-sided second-round stoppage of fellow Briton Fabio Wardley in a title rematch last month. Germany's Agit Kabayel holds the WBC belt while Croatian Filip Hrgovic is the IBF champion, both managed by Warren. Russia's Murat Gassiev has the WBA title.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 再送-人間の自由意思「ＡＩに明け渡すべきでない」、アンソロピックＣＥＯが報道に反論
item.description:
(見出しを修正して再送します)
[２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
(見出しを修正して再送します)

[２５日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２５日、人間がＡＩシステムに自由意思を明け渡すべきだという考えを明確に否定した。

これに先立ち、米ニュースサイトのアクシオスは関係者の話として、ＡＩ業界のトップ経営者らが、人類は意思決定権の一部を超知能ＡＩシステムに明け渡すべきだとの考えへの反発を強めていると報道。この考えはアンソロピック内部に共通して見られるものだとした上で、批判派はこうした流れが自由意思の放棄につながりかねないと懸念していると伝えた。アモデイ氏はこの報道に反論した形となった。

アモデイ氏はＸへの投稿で、「人間の自由意思をＡＩシステムに明け渡すべきだとは思わない。私がそう考えているかのように示唆するのはばかげている」と述べた。

同氏は、自身がこれまで数百ページに及ぶエッセーを書いてきたと指摘し、その一貫したテーマは、ＡＩが正当な民主的プロセスによって統治される必要があるということだと説明した。

専制政治は民主主義の煩雑なプロセスよりも優れた、速い、あるいは決然とした意思決定につながると、専制政治の擁護者たちが何千年も主張してきたと指摘。その上で「効率や安全を祭壇に捧げて、正当性や自己決定を犠牲にすべきでは決してない」とし、この専制批判はまさにＡＩによる統治にも当てはまると述べた。

また、自身の文章やインタビューを注意深く読んだ人なら、自分が違うことを信じていると結論づけることはできないはずだと主張。数カ月前のＣＢＳのインタビューでも、ＡＩが民主的に統治されることを明確に求めたと指摘した。

さらにアモデイ氏は、自著「Machines of Loving Grace」で民主主義の再活性化にＡＩを使うことについて詳述し、市民の意思決定を助ける道具としてのＡＩの活用に触れていると説明。「意見を集約して市民の間の合意形成を促し、対立を解消し、共通基盤を見いだし、妥協点を探る」ものだとした上で「明白な含意は、政治や統治の決定を下すのは人間であり続けるべきだということだ」と述べた。

アモデイ氏はそのほか、ＡＩを一貫して過度に使用すれば深刻な雇用の混乱を招く恐れがあり、人々が適応する時間を確保するため、一部のＡＩ導入を遅らせたり停止したりすることが理にかなう場合もあるとした。

item.title: PM Carney says Pentagon’s complaints about Canada haven’t come up in Trump talks
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney says the Pentagon’s recent complaints about Canada’s defence spending have not come up in his conversations with U.S. President Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: OTTAWA — Prime Minister Mark Carney says the Pentagon’s recent complaints about Canada’s defence spending have not come up in his conversations with U.S. President Donald Trump. On Monday, the Pentagon released what it called a “fact sheet” claiming Canada’s defence spending has limited its ability to contribute to the protection of North America. Asked about those complaints on his way into the Liberal caucus meeting on Wednesday, Carney said Trump hasn’t brought up those concerns with him. “I can assure you that in my discussions with the president the United States, we’re focused on conflict resolution around the world and he has not raised issues such as has been reported recently,” Carney said. The prime minister said Canada is taking responsibility for its own defence. He said Canada is on the front lines in Europe through Operation Reassurance in Latvia and is engaging with NATO partners to secure the Arctic and the Far North. Carney also said Canada is making “historic investments” in its military and getting members of the armed forces the pay they deserve. Under U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, the Trump administration has taken symbolic steps to upend the long-standing bilateral defence relationship between Canada and the United States. Hegseth last week issued a classified memo imposing restrictions on military co-operation with Canada on think-tanks and socializing. Defence Minister David McGuinty said Tuesday he can’t “divine” the thinking behind the Pentagon’s recent criticism of Canada’s defence spending. “The amount of co-operation that we are pursuing together under Norad has not changed. What we are doing together at NATO has not changed,” McGuinty told reporters in Ottawa. “Our military-to-military co-operation has not changed.” Stephen Fuhr, secretary of state for defence procurement, suggested Wednesday that the Pentagon’s “briefing books haven’t been updated recently.” He cited Canada hitting NATO’s two per cent spending target earlier this year and its plans to buy new submarines, radar units and aircraft. “Our readiness has been not where we want it to be, and we all acknowledge that, but we’re making great progress and changing it. We’re buying new capabilities, we’re moving faster, more people are joining the Canadian Forces,” he told reporters before the caucus meeting Wednesday. “If we were to react to every single thing that came out of the United States, we’d have a headache. I don’t think they either know or appreciate how fast we’re moving.” A senior U.S. Department of Defense official said Hegseth’s memo was intended to ensure a unified objective during engagements with Canada. It does not affect military operations. The Trump administration official briefed a small group of Canadian journalists Monday on background in order to speak more candidly about Canada-U.S. relations. The official, who said the Pentagon is looking for Canada to commit to a realistic approach focused on military efficiency, cited the F-35 review. The Liberal government has yet to reach a decision on its full order of F-35 fighter jets from Lockheed Martin — which Pentagon officials have cited as a source of frustration. Canada has committed to buy 16 of the aircraft, but the decision on the remainder of the planned 88-aircraft order has been the subject of a political review for more than a year. On Wednesday, Fuhr rejected the idea that the Pentagon was putting pressure on Ottawa to purchase the jets. He said Canada is still buying military equipment from the United States but is also diversifying into other markets and spending more of its defence dollars at home. Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre told reporters after question period on Wednesday that Hegseth should not dictate how Canada spends its defence dollars. But he also took issue with how the Liberals have been doling out defence spending and claimed the government is lining the pockets of lobbyists and corporations rather than helping military personnel. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 25, 2026. With files from Nick Murray in Ottawa and Kelly Geraldine Malone in Washington Craig Lord, The Canadian Press

item.title: 原油先物上昇、サウジ最大製油所攻撃で供給混乱懸念
item.description:
Nicole Jao Anna Hirtenstein
[ニューヨーク ２５日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は、北海ブレントが３％超、米ＷＴＩが２％上昇した。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビア最大のラス・タヌラ製油所を攻撃したと表明したことで、中東産原油の供給混乱への懸念が高まっている。
清算値は北海ブレント先物が３．２１ドル（３．５％）高の１バレル＝９４．６１ドル、米ＷＴＩ先物
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nicole Jao　Anna Hirtenstein

[ニューヨーク ２５日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は、北海ブレントが３％超、米ＷＴＩが２％上昇した。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビア最大のラス・タヌラ製油所を攻撃したと表明したことで、中東産原油の供給混乱への懸念が高まっている。

清算値は北海ブレント先物が３．２１ドル（３．５％）高の１バレル＝９４．６１ドル、米ＷＴＩ先物 が１．６３ドル（２．０％）高の８３．６８ドル。両先物は前日は２％超上昇していた。

ラス・タヌラ製油所の精製能力は日量５５万バレル。ペルシャ湾沿岸にある主要輸出ターミナル付きの複合施設の一部で、過去にも攻撃対象になっていた。

ＰＶＭの石油アナリスト、タマス・バルガ氏は、フーシ派の表明を受け地政学リスク・プレミアムが上昇し、原油高につながったと指摘。２６日の米国の感謝祭（サンクスギビングデー）の祝日を前に、売り持ち（ショートポジション）の買い戻しが進んだ可能性もあると述べた。

プライス・フューチャーズ・グループのアナリスト、フィル・フリン氏も、市場では週末を控え地政学的緊張の高まりが警戒されているとしている。

この日はこのほか、イランの革命防衛隊がイラン国営メディアに対し、原油輸送の要衝ホルムズ海峡でコンテナ船１隻が２４日に「無許可」の航路を航行していた際に標的となり、航行を停止したと明らかにした。

item.title: Judge Clears New York City Rent Freeze Backed by Mayor Mamdani
item.description: A rent freeze backed by New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s administration was cleared by a state judge who dismissed a lawsuit filed by a group of landlords seeking to void the measure, which went into effect last month.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: (Bloomberg) -- A rent freeze backed by New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s administration was cleared by a state judge who dismissed a lawsuit filed by a group of landlords seeking to void the measure, which went into effect last month.The landlords sued the city’s Rent Guidelines Board in July, arguing that Mamdani improperly influenced the vote and ignored evidence of rising operating costs for building owners. A judge on Wednesday threw out the case, saying the decision to implement the freeze was not “unreasonable, arbitrary or capricious” and must be upheld.But the judge, Brendan T. Lantry, sharply criticized Mamdani’s campaign promises to freeze the rent. The mayor’s comments were “reckless and irresponsible” because only the board can raise, freeze or adjust the rent of stabilized units in the city, the judge wrote. Correspondence between the mayor’s office and the board about the measure was “troubling” and “puts a dark shadow over the purported ‘independence’ of the board,” but it doesn’t show that the mayor dictated the decision, Lantry said.“The court recognizes that political candidates routinely comment on prevalent policy issues while running for an elected position, but to guarantee a rent freeze to millions of New Yorkers without the authority to do so, is irresponsible and, quite frankly, invited” the lawsuit, the judge wrote. Still, there is “nothing to suggest the guideline-setting process was an orchestrated ‘sham process,” Lantry said.In a statement, Mamdani cheered the decision. “This is a victory for tenants, for affordability and for the principle that working New Yorkers deserve a city they can afford to live in,” he said. “Because housing is not a luxury. It is a basic necessity. This holiday weekend, more than two million New Yorkers can breathe a little easier.”Randy Mastro, a lawyer for the landlords and a former deputy mayor in the Giuliani administration who has also challenged the pied-a-terre tax backed by Mamdani, didn’t respond to a message seeking comment.The suit came weeks after the board voted for the first time ever to freeze rents for both one-year and two-year leases for roughly 1 million stabilized apartments. The last one-year rent freeze was during the pandemic in 2020.Courts have historically deferred to the Rent Guidelines Board. A state court judge dismissed a challenge by landlords to a 2016 rent freeze. While that lawsuit claimed the board didn’t account for finances of the building, this challenge focused on the mayor’s involvement. Mamdani made the freeze a centerpiece of his mayoral campaign, contending that tenants squeezed by years of rising housing costs needed immediate relief. After taking office, he appointed a majority of the board’s members. A member of the board who represented landlords, Christina Smyth, resigned in protest hours before the vote. Tenant advocates hailed the vote as a long-overdue reset after inflation and housing shortages left many renters facing mounting financial pressure. Landlord and housing industry groups have warned that the freeze will make it harder for owners to maintain aging buildings and finance fixes as insurance, taxes and repair costs have surged amid a tight rental market.The case is Kenilworth Holdings LLC v New York City Rent Guidelines Board, 453580/2026, New York State Supreme Court, New York County.--With assistance from Laura Nahmias.More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

item.title: Goldman Sachs advierte que aún es pronto para aprovechar la caída de las acciones de IA
item.description: Un estratega de Goldman Sachs advierte que los mercados siguen siendo frágiles y que los inversionistas necesitan ver beneficios reales de las multimillonarias inversiones en inteligencia artificial.
item.dc:creator: Matt Clinch, Stephen Carroll
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los inversionistas necesitan ver ganancias reales derivadas de los miles de millones de dólares que se están destinando al desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial, según Christian Mueller-Glissmann, de Goldman Sachs Group Inc. ( GS ), quien además advirtió que aún es demasiado pronto para comprar acciones. Los mercados atraviesan una “fase bastante frágil”, afirmó Mueller-Glissmann, jefe de investigación de asignación de activos, en una entrevista con Bloomberg Television. El mercado está preocupado por la rentabilidad del capital invertido, mientras que el costo del capital sigue siendo elevado, añadió. Ver más: JPMorgan sitúa al S&P 500 en 8.200 puntos para 2027, por debajo del consenso Afirmó que el posicionamiento aún no ha alcanzado los niveles necesarios para determinar un mínimo, y señaló que el agregador de apetito de riesgo de Goldman “no está realmente en niveles en los que podamos determinar un mínimo fácilmente sin más ayuda de los fundamentos”. Según Mueller-Glissmann, la fuerza estabilizadora más clara sería un giro de los bancos centrales hacia una postura más moderada, lo cual, según argumentó, está justificado en Estados Unidos dado que la tasa de inflación implícita en el mercado se sitúa en general en línea con el objetivo de la Reserva Federal. Mueller-Glissmann advirtió que una corrección prolongada conlleva riesgos económicos, señalando que la asignación de los hogares a acciones estadounidenses es mayor que durante la burbuja de las puntocom. Ver más: Morgan Stanley ve en la caída del S&P 500 la oportunidad de compra que esperaba y revela dónde invertir Según explicó, los diferenciales de crédito se están ampliando de forma constante, y su mayor preocupación es que se repita el episodio de finales de 2018. En aquel caso, el endurecimiento monetario de la Reserva Federal provocó un impacto tan negativo en las expectativas de crecimiento económico y avivó la turbulencia en los mercados que el banco central se vio obligado a flexibilizar su política monetaria. “Si nos quedamos donde estamos, sin estabilizar la situación y sin que las acciones se recuperen, habrá un daño significativo al crecimiento”, dijo. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

FAST

LONDON, Nov 25 : South Africa captain Siya Kolisi said Rassie Erasmus's ban was tough on the team but they would not use it as an excuse and planned a hotel celebration with the coach if they won Sunday's inaugural Nations Championship final against France. World Rugby has banned Erasmus for six matches, including the final at Twickenham, for criticising match officials. The suspension applies to any match-day involvement including coaching, entering the stadium or coaches’ box, communicating with match officials or engaging in media duties. "There's stuff that we can't control and there's nothing we can do about it," Kolisi told reporters at a media event at Twickenham on Wednesday where South Africa were alone among the 12 participating sides with no coaching staff accompanying the captain.

The absentees included assistant coach Mzwandile Stick, who made the team announcement on Monday in the isiXhosa language. Every other team had both coach and captain present. "All we can do is go to training, prepare, watch videos and prepare our mindset for the game... and the coach is there with us, every single training session until we have to go and play the game," said Kolisi. "We're not going to make excuses, saying that 'oh, it's been a big thing, our coach is not at the stadium'. We know. It's tough. It's good to have him there but now he's not there we have to make it work as a group."    Sunday's final pitches the reigning World Cup holders against the reigning Six Nations champions, the best of the southern and northern hemispheres, less than a year before the next World Cup in Australia. France beat South Africa 21-19 in Paris this month. "He'll be at the hotel... so we'll go and celebrate with him," said Kolisi. "He's coaching us, he's within us. The only difference is that he's not there on Saturday (Sunday), which is tough, it is tough for us as a team, but you can't make excuses, it is what is happening right now. "As a coach it's shared, it's the same as my leadership. I'm the captain here but in the group everybody's in charge of something. It's not nice not having him there because he helps us a lot, and then obviously at halftime when he comes in and talks. "But the whole week he can still drive and coach us and decide and we'd love to do it for him." Kolisi rejected suggestions that South Africa were tired from the four-test 'Rugby's Greatest Rivalry' series against New Zealand in August and September. The All Blacks have also lost twice in the Nations Championship, a shock defeat to Wales and a record drubbing by England. "People are talking about being tired from Greatest Rivalry, that's nonsense," said the captain. "We're fine. The way we are playing is making us tired because we're not doing the things that we normally do."

Source: Reuters

item.title: San Francisco Coastline Is Swamped by Record-High King Tides
item.description: Record flooding from king tides is inundating the California coast Wednesday, compounded by a Pacific storm that’s contributing to flight delays in San Francisco.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: (Bloomberg) -- Record flooding from king tides is inundating the California coast Wednesday, compounded by a Pacific storm that’s contributing to flight delays in San Francisco.Tuesday’s high tide of 8.23 feet (2.51 meters) was the largest ever recorded in the city during the month of November. Wednesday’s high tide may surpass it, said Sebastian Westerink, a US National Weather Service meteorologist in Monterey.“Today and tomorrow around noon are going to be the worst,” Westerink said. “Then it is going to start lowering from there.”About 145 flights through San Francisco International Airport were delayed Wednesday, according to FlightAware, a tracking site.Flood warnings remain across San Francisco, much of the Bay Area and the Pacific coastline. Gauges on Wednesday in Santa Barbara and San Diego recorded their highest tides ever, the weather service said, breaking records set about a month ago.Rough seas and dangerous swells have been spotted along California’s shores. Authorities in Marin County north of San Francisco issued a “shelter-in-place” order to residents in the Calles area of Stinson Beach as waves push past the beach. There’s also an evacuation warning in Stinson Beach — a community of 541 people — as large waves are expected through 2 p.m. local time.Evacuation warnings are in effect more than 300 miles (483 km) south in Ventura County. The alerts encompass waterfront neighborhoods recently fortified with protective berms.California’s king tides, the highest predicted tides of the year, recur when the sun, moon and Earth align and the moon is closest to Earth. This year, they’re arriving after El Niño helped raise sea levels and powerful waves battered the state’s coastline, damaging roads and destroying homes.Travel has become dangerous at times: King tides have forced road closures and shut down portions of the Pacific Coast Highway in Orange County, south of Los Angeles.--With assistance from Todd Woody.(Updates with flight delays in 4th paragraph. An earlier version corrected a detail involving Stinson Beach evacuation warning.)More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル下落、ＡＩ株急落で円・スイスフランに逃避買い 5:36 配信

3月24日撮影の米ドル紙幣。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　２５日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、安全資産とされるスイスフランと日本円が上昇する一方、ドルが下落した。株式市場では人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄が急落し、波乱の一日となったが、株価はその後、序盤の下げ幅の大半を取り戻した。

ＡＩ関連株への売りが再燃する中、ハイテク株比率の高いナスダック総合指数は、一時４％近く下落した後、下げ幅を約０．６％まで縮小した。こうした中、ドルは取引序盤にリスク回避の動きで買われたものの、取引終盤にかけて下落した。ドルは株価急落時に安全資産として機能してきたが、ＡＩ関連銘柄に関連した資本流入や成長期待にも左右される。

この日発表の経済指標では、１０月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．８％上昇し、９月の３．６％上昇から伸びが加速した。変動の大きい食品・エネルギーを除くコアＰＣＥ価格指数は前年比３．３％上昇し、２０２３年１１月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。これを受け、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２７年初めまで利上げを続けるとの観測が強まった。

ＣＩＢＣキャピタル・マーケッツの為替戦略責任者サラ・イン氏は「より大きな問題は、ターミナルレート（利上げの最終到達点）がどこに落ち着くかだ」と述べた。

一方、トランプ政権が提案した、日本、中国、欧州連合（ＥＵ）を含む１４の貿易相手国・地域への新たな関税措置に対する市場の反応は限定的だった。前出のイン氏は、関税は想定済みで市場への影響はなかったと指摘。「これは『解放の日』の第２弾ではない」と述べた。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２２％安の１０３．６２。

ユーロは０．１７％高の１ユーロ＝１．０９８３ドルとなった。

円は対ドルで０．０６％高の１ドル＝１５９．１３円。ドルは対スイスフランでは０．６３％安の０．８３フランとなった。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは０．３３％高の６万００５０ドル。

始値 159.28

高値 159.40

安値 158.68

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.0971/1.0973

BERLIN: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz accused Russia on Wednesday (Nov 25) of "escalating" threats to European security as he defended his government's plans to bolster defence spending and maintain financial aid to Ukraine. Opposition parties, including t he far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD), which tops national opinion polls, and t he hard-left Die Linke, have called for an end to military aid to Kyiv . "It cannot be s aid often enough, against t he far right as much as t he far left: Russia knows exactly what it wants . And Russia wants more than Ukraine," Merz told t he Bundestag lower house of parliament during a debate on t he 2027 draft budget. "Russia is escalating in t he Baltic region, in Poland, on t he Black Sea; Russia is escalating in space, and Russia is by now also escalating massively he re in our own country," he s aid .

Russia did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on Merz 's accusations. It has repeatedly denied seeking military confrontation with NATO countries and says its actions in Ukraine are aimed at protecting its own national security. Merz 's government blamed Russia in September for an attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle airport , an accusation t he Russian Embassy in Berlin dismissed as part of a "new wave of anti-Russian hysteria in Germany". Germany and ot he r European countries have also been hit by a wave of cyberattacks and sabotage incidents targeting critical infrastructure that t he y have often blamed on Russia. Moscow has denied all t he allegations.

"LEARNING FROM UKRAINE" Merz s aid on Wednesday that by supporting Ukraine, Germany was also protecting itself. "We are learning from Ukraine - technologically for civilian use but of course also in defence technology," he s aid . Germany has been Ukraine's biggest military backer in Europe since Russia's full-blown invasion on Feb 24, 2022, but public support for this policy has decreased amid cost-of-living pressures. A poll publis he d on Tuesday showed a narrow majority of Germans now oppose giving military aid to Kyiv . "Whose chancellor are you, actually?" AfD co-leader Tino Chrupalla asked Merz during Wednesday's debate, accusing the government of supporting Ukraine while failing to provide sufficient relief to German citizens. "What a mockery!" Germany aims to double defence spending to over €200 billion (US$228 billion) between now and 2030, according to t he 2027 draft budget, hitting 3.7 per cent of national output by 2030, in line with commitments to NATO.

EU SHOULD FOCUS ON SECURITY AND COMPETITIVENESS, MERZ SAYS Merz also addressed on Wednesday t he latest proposal for t he European Union budget for 2028-2034 presented by European Council chief Antonio Costa. Costa proposed cuts that would reduce t he overall seven-year budget to €1.582 trillion, some €40 billion less than a proposal presented by t he Irish EU presidency in October. EU leaders will discuss Costa's proposals at a special summit on Thursday and Friday. "In t he se negotiations I am pushing for spending to be limited and focused on what really makes Europe stronger: security and competitiveness," Merz s aid . "If spending is focused, it is t he best additional insurance for our country."

item.title: Loonie jumps as Macklem stays hawkish
item.description: The Canadian dollar jumped higher than it has in more than three months on Tuesday, as the Bank of Canada (BoC) signalled that it’s still worried about persistent inflation, which is also being felt ...
item.dc:creator: Jordan Fleguel
item.content:encoded: The Canadian dollar jumped higher than it has in more than three months on Tuesday, as the Bank of Canada (BoC) signalled that it’s still worried about persistent inflation, which is also being felt south of the border. With inflation running hot in both Canada and the U.S., largely due to months of elevated global oil prices, markets have priced in rate hikes from both the BoC and U.S. Federal Reserve at their next respective meetings. “The loonie follows the interest rate differentials,” Rahim Madhavji, president of Knightsbridge Foreign Exchange, told BNN Bloomberg on Wednesday. “If the BoC and the Fed raise rates in tandem, that generally bodes well for the loonie.” Bank of Canada governor Tiff Macklem said on Tuesday in a speech at the Economic Club of Canada in Toronto that he expects “more pass-through to consumer prices in the year ahead,” despite the oil price relief seen in recent weeks. “This second-round effect of the oil shock will add to inflation persistence,” he said in prepared remarks, suggesting the BoC is prepared to raise rates for a second straight time next month in an effort to tame inflationary pressures. “The BoC with the speech yesterday basically has said: ‘Look, we’re going to raise rates.’ That differential has caught up, and that’s why the loonie basically repriced as a result of that interest rate differential,” Madhavji said. The Canadian dollar was up 0.49 per cent to more than 70 cents US in midday trading on Wednesday. Loonie supported by trade talks The signing of a new trade deal between Canada and the U.S. is another factor that would positively impact the Canadian dollar, according to Madhavji. “I think an announcement of a firm trade deal would be beneficial for Canada and would be beneficial for the loonie. It would be beneficial for certainty in businesses and investment going down the line,” he said. “The uncertainty and the lack of a trade deal is hurting the Canadian dollar. So, the fact that there’s been noise that we’re close to a deal, almost have a deal, looking for a fair deal; that bodes well for the loonie.” Trade talks between Canada and the U.S. have been taking place for months but seem to have heated up in recent weeks. U.S. President Donald Trump’s chief trade representative said on Wednesday that negotiations with Canada are continuing, but the two sides remain stuck on a few pressure points including around steel, aluminum and autos. “We want to make sure that North American trade in these products is beneficial to the United States. Obviously, there would have to be something that accommodates Canada as well,” said U.S. Trade Rep. Jamieson Greer in morning interview on CNBC. Greer’s comments came after yet another round of proposed U.S. tariffs, announced by the Trump administration Wednesday, targeting major trading partners including China, the European Union and Japan over subsidized production. Canada was not among them. “Until a deal is made, we basically have to keep waiting and seeing what’s exactly going to happen. We’re always one tweet away from some other type of news event, or increased tariffs, or a renegotiation or repricing of something,” Madhavji said. “So, you really need a firm deal, and people need to believe that the deal is going to be in place and that it’s firm, but a trade deal obviously benefits the Canadian dollar.” With files from CTV News’ Luca Caruso-Moro, The Canadian Press and The Associated Press

Explainer-How China got access to Nvidia’s AI chips despite rules to stop them

Nov 25 (Reuters) – AI chips are a central battleground in the US-China technology race. To preserve its lead, in recent years Washington has imposed and revised rules to restrict China’s access to advanced semiconductors and chipmaking technology, while balancing national security concerns with trade considerations.

The drama around Nvidia, the top US exporter of AI chips to China, has thrust those rules into the spotlight.

Delving into the resulting regulations is a quagmire. Export control rules are often likened to the US tax code in their complexity and constant revision.

Show Full Article

Here are some basics for understanding what’s legal, and what’s not, when it comes to China’s access to US AI chips:

When did the US start to restrict chips to China?

In October 2022, the US unveiled sweeping restrictions on advanced chips to China, marking the biggest shift in US policy toward exporting technology to China in decades.

A year later, it tightened the rules to capture more chips and stop chip designers such as Nvidia from selling products engineered to fall just below the performance thresholds of the earlier restrictions. It also expanded the restrictions to countries in the Middle East and restricted chips to overseas companies headquartered in China.

In January 2025, the Biden administration extended the restrictions globally, imposing a worldwide license requirement. But in May, days before it was set to take effect, the Trump administration announced it would not enforce that rule.

The Trump administration only formally rescinded and replaced the rule last week, leaving a gap that allowed data center capacity to proliferate in countries such as Singapore, where Chinese companies could rent computing power remotely to train and deploy AI models.

Did Megaspeed, the Singapore cloud company whose former executive allegedly had an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, operate legally?

For over two years, authorities have been investigating whether Megaspeed diverted chips to China, which would be illegal. But companies in countries including Singapore were allowed to buy advanced AI chips for their data centers license-free until the US issued a new rule last week cutting off that practice.

Megaspeed likely won’t be getting any more chips. It was added to a US trade blacklist this week, along with its Thai and Malaysian subsidiaries, essentially blocking shipments. Nvidia also said it cut off sales to Megaspeed in June 2025.

Are Nvidia’s shipments of AI chips to China legal?

About a year ago, President Donald Trump allowed Nvidia to ship its H200 chip to China, drawing criticism from experts who said the chips would help jumpstart China’s military modernization and erode the US lead in AI. The H200 chip is one of Nvidia’s more advanced chips, but not top-of-the-line.

Nvidia cannot simply ship the chips to Chinese companies that pay for them. Nvidia must apply for licenses from the US Department of Commerce, which has issued them since last spring on a case-by-case basis.

Last week, the House Foreign Affairs Committee released licensing data showing the Trump administration approved shipments of nearly 900,000 advanced AI chips made by Nvidia and AMD for Chinese companies from December 2025 through May 2026.

What does the new Trump administration rule do?

Last week, the Trump administration issued a new regulation, adding license requirements for five countries including Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand, in an effort to crack down on chips being smuggled into China.

Prior to that, the chip-based license requirement generally applied to countries like Russia that raise national security concerns, along with companies headquartered in arms-embargoed countries. Now they also apply to Southeast Asian countries viewed as transshipment points with a high risk for illegal diversion to China.

The rule also clamped down on AI chip sales to non-US data centers that supply a high volume of computing power to Chinese-headquartered firms.

How big a problem is chip smuggling?

For years, Nvidia’s Huang has said there is no evidence of chip smuggling to China.

But that assertion, which experts already viewed skeptically, was further questioned in March when US prosecutors charged three people associated with California-based AI server maker Super Micro Computer, including its co-founder, in a scheme to divert about $2.5 billion of US technology into China, including AI servers packed with Nvidia AI chips.

Critics say Nvidia has tried to minimize a well-known risk. Huang once said Nvidia’s sophisticated Grace Blackwell AI chip platform weighed nearly two tons (1.8 metric tons) and could not fit into a pocket or backpack. But servers are not smuggled in backpacks. They are routed through third countries and intermediary companies.

Supporters say Nvidia may not have had verified evidence of diversion and that the company cannot keep tabs on all its products after they’re sold.

Can Nvidia track its chips to see where they end up?

Nvidia has built location verification technology that could indicate which country its chips are operating in, the company confirmed in December 2025. It has offered the feature as a software option for customers.

But the company has opposed proposed legislation that would require location verification and diversion reporting for advanced AI processors.

A measure known as the Chip Security Act is among several export control bills that gained new momentum in the wake of the Nvidia scandal, and may be included in the National Defense Authorization Act that Congress is expected to pass next month.

(Reporting by Karen Freifeld. Editing by Chris Sanders and David Gaffen)

item.title: Investor Outlook: Groupe Dynamite price target cut to $83
item.description: Groupe Dynamite reports earnings Dec. 8 after a June selloff that followed a cut to its store-opening forecast.
item.dc:creator: BNN Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: Groupe Dynamite shares have struggled to recover from a nearly 36 per cent drop in June, when the retailer scaled back its store-opening forecast. Its next earnings report is due Dec. 8. BNN Bloomberg spoke with Mauricio Serna, executive director at UBS, about how the Canadian retailer stacks up against Aritzia and Abercrombie and what could set apparel brands apart in 2027. Key Takeaways Read the full transcript below: ROGER: UBS has cut its price target on Groupe Dynamite from $112 Canadian to $83, but is sticking with its buy rating. So, what’s behind the downgrade? Why does the analyst still see significant upside, and what does it say about the broader apparel retail sector? For more on this, we’re joined by Mauricio Serna, executive director at UBS. And Mauricio, thanks very much for joining us. MAURICIO: Good morning. Thanks for having me. ROGER: OK, why the change? MAURICIO: Yes. So our fundamental view on Groupe Dynamite is still bullish. We like the story. We think, you know, they have a differentiated strategy to drive very attractive long-term growth. However, we are taking a more measured approach on the valuation, just because we see increased caution on the consumer environment. You know, we see a lot of macro uncertainty. You know, we’ve heard companies reporting Q3 numbers in the last couple of weeks talking about a slow start of the quarter. So, just we believe at this point, a heightened macro uncertainty justifies a lower valuation multiple. So we think in this environment, you know, better to use a lower multiple than we would — than what we were using before. So we take him down the multiple that we were using to value the stock instead of, you know, using a 27 times P/E. That was our prior multiple. Now we think, you know, given the environment, you know, the market will probably be willing to pay for a good story like Groupe Dynamite, something like 20 times P/E, and that’s essentially the multiple that we’re using to get to $83 Canadian price target, which still implies a pretty sizable upside of over 60 per cent based on the current stock price. ROGER: So you still have optimism for it. Is that Spruce Point — the comments from them? Is that having an effect? Is that a factor at all right now? Any concerns with what they were saying? MAURICIO: So we haven’t really spent time, you know, looking at that report. Our sense, just on our checks, is that the brand Garage, you know, which is the key driver behind the story, maintains robust momentum, especially in the U.S., and that’s where, like, where we see the strong growth potential over time because it’s — it has a lot of white space opportunities. Again, I think it’s more coming from what we’re hearing from our own research, you know, about the U.S. consumer environment. We put out this note every month, and it’s our industry outlook. And in this report, it, it takes into account the response of a — 8,000 U.S. consumers and their view of the economy. And they seem to have concerns about inflation, about potential job loss. So these kind of caution, I think, it’s, you know, trickles down to — can trickle down, trickle down to stocks and sentiment around the specialty retailers like Groupe Dynamite. So that’s where we’re coming from when, you know, when we’re taking this more cautious approach in terms of the — in terms of the valuation and price target for the stock. ROGER: OK, it had that big selloff in June, but it’s raised its full-year guidance, improved margins, stronger sales. What are you going to be looking for next week? MAURICIO: Yes, I think next week or the week after. ROGER: Sorry, might be the week after. MAURICIO: The week after. Yes, you’re right. Dec. 8. For us, you know, we think they had a pretty strong third quarter. So we see a beat on sales and EPS, given the robust momentum in the U.S. As I mentioned before, I think looking into the print, it’s all going to come down to what commentary they provide about fourth quarter, quarter to date. You know, as, as I mentioned earlier, the companies that have announced so far have had some sort of cautionary comment, just because primarily November has been a slow start to the holiday season, and partly due to unseasonably warm weather. I think, you know, it all comes down to, you know, how trends industry-wise evolve over the next two weeks. But we are confident about Groupe Dynamite because it’s one of the brands that we see with very strong momentum, and we think that, you know, they can continue to point to, you know, a somewhat of a, like, a 10 per cent comp for the quarter, which is consistent with, with what they’ve been doing the last couple — the last quarter and their message coming out of the Q2 call. So I think that consistency is what could help investors get more confident about the company’s ability to deliver sustainable and attractive long-term growth. ROGER: And within the industry, things — groups like Aritzia, Abercrombie. How tight is the market right now? Especially if consumers are tightening the purse strings on their, on their wallets. MAURICIO: I think, you know, what we’ve seen in specialty apparel is there’s always, you know, ebbs and flows on the brands that are outperforming. You know, the consumers still shopping. I think it’s more of a game of, you know, market share gainers and donors. I think the some — the companies that you’ve mentioned are good examples of companies that have been taking market share. Because either the product that they’re coming out is resonating with consumer, you know, they’re investing in things like marketing, digital, AI, and I do believe that Groupe Dynamite probably belongs in that group as well. Just, you know, given their track record and their ongoing investments as they continue to expand their business. ROGER: And overall, heading into 2027, what are you looking for from the retail sector? MAURICIO: Yes, I mean, I think going into ’27, you know, we’re coming in, at least in the U.S., maybe like the — in the first half of the year, there’s a bit of a concern because consumers will be lapping, you know, tax refunds, so that, you know, has become — is a topic that a lot of investors are bringing up. I think we’re looking for companies that are able to show resilience because they have brands that, you know, are — have been building on momentum, that they can carry on that momentum. Also have very agile ways to react to consumers’ taste in, in terms of fashion, and, you know, that they continue to invest in, in growth because, you know, in, in specialty apparel and overall soft lines, that tends to be the biggest factor that drives stock performance over time. ROGER: OK, we have to wrap it up there, Mauricio. But always appreciate chatting with you. Thanks for joining us. MAURICIO: Great. Thanks for having me. Have a great day. ROGER: You too, Mauricio Serna, executive director at UBS. --- This BNN Bloomberg summary and transcript of the Nov. 25, 2026 interview with Mauricio Serna are published with the assistance of AI. 欧州市場サマリー（25日） 4:50 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞　続落して取引を終えた。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に続落した。銀行や鉱業株の売り注文が優勢だった一方、景気変動の影響を受けにくい銘柄が物色され、相場を下支えした。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．９３％安だった。銀行大手スタンダード・チャータードは４．７％、ライオン・ファイナンス・グループは４．２％それぞれ下落した。金の値下がりを受けて、ＦＴＳＥ３５０種貴金属株指数は２．９１％安。航空宇宙・防衛株指数は２．７８％安。エンジンメーカーのロールスロイスは３．９％下落した。一方、生活必需品株指数は１．２３％高。日用品のレキット・ベンキーザーは１．３％上昇。ユニリーバは米マコーミックとの統合に関する英競争当局の見解が前向きなものとして好材料視され、２．２％値上がりした。たばこのインペリアル・ブランズは６．１％高。モルガン・スタンレーによる目標株価の引き上げを受けて、買われた。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞　続落して取引を終えた。銀行やハイテク株の売り注文が目立った。利上げ観測の高まりや米関税措置を巡る不透明感、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連を巡る先行き懸念が相場の重荷となった。ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は３．３２％、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種銀行株指数は２．９６％それぞれ下落した。テクノロジー株指数は３．１１％安。オランダのハイテク投資会社プロサス は４．９％値下がりした。一方、自動車・部品株指数は１．４８％上昇。ＪＰモルガンによる強気のリポートを受けて、ドイツの自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）は３．４％、ＢＭＷは３．７％それぞれ上昇した。業績予想を上方修正したフランスの蒸留酒メーカー、レミー・コアントローは１３．１％上昇した。１０月の米コア個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年同月比の伸びが市場予想を上回った。これを受けて、１２月の米利上げ観測が高まった。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が１２月会合で利上げするとの見方が強い。米政権は主要貿易相手国・地域に新たな関税措置を提案。欧州連合（ＥＵ）は、米国との間で合意した関税率上限１５％と整合するものになるとの認識を示した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　域内国債利回りが低下した。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株への売りが続いて米主要株価指数が急落し、投資家が相対的に安全な国債に資金を移した。域内の指標となるドイツ１０年債利回りは４．５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下し、３．２２％となった。一時は１１月６日以来の低水準を付けた。ドイツ２年債利回りは４．５ｂｐ低下の３．０２％。半導体大手エヌビディア のジェンスン・フアン氏が２３日に最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に復帰したことで株価は上昇したが、ＡＩを巡る疑念はくすぶっている。米議員からは同氏の再任を批判する声が上がった。フランス１０年債利回りは４．５ｂｐ、イタリア１０年債利回りは３．５ｂｐ低下した。短期金融市場ではＥＣＢの利上げ観測が後退。２０２７年７月までに織り込まれた金融引き締め幅は、２３日の約６０ｂｐから直近では約５５ｂｐに縮小した。

FAST

BAKU, Azerbaijan, Nov 25 : Anthony Gordon scored twice as Barcelona cruised to a 4-1 victory at Sabah in the Champions League on Wednesday, maintaining Hansi Flick's side's push for a top-eight finish with their fourth victory from five league-phase matches. Karim Adeyemi and Gabriel Jesus also struck in the space of five second-half minutes for the Spanish giants, who are fourth in Europe's elite club competition while Azerbaijani minnows Sabah are 32nd. Barcelona had been frustrated for periods in the first half before Adeyemi, filling in on the right wing for the injured Lamine Yamal, delivered a cross that goalkeeper Stas Pokatilov could only palm to the edge of the six-yard box and Gordon tapped home from close range. Six minutes after the restart, Pokatilov parried a Jesus effort straight into Gordon's path and the England forward made no mistake.

Adeyemi then scored himself in the 55th minute before Jesus added a fourth five minutes later as Barcelona's superior quality began to tell. Sabah briefly lifted the crowd at the Baku Olympic Stadium when Joy-Lance Mickels found the net after the hour mark. "Especially in the second half, we controlled the game and also scored these goals, the intensity was good, and so I was happy with that," said Flick, who rotated his squad to rest several key players. "Three points here, it's important, but it's always not easy these games." With goal difference potentially decisive in the race for direct qualification to the last 16, Barcelona continued to press until the final whistle without adding to their tally. Flick left Lamine out of the travelling squad due to an ankle injury.

Source: Reuters

item.description: [２５日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・レーティングは２５日、米半導体大手エヌビディアの信用格付けを、引き下げ方...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ｓ＆Ｐ、エヌビディアを格下げ方向で見直し　ガバナンス巡るリスク指摘 4:39 配信

11月23日、米カリフォルニア州サンタクララのエヌビディア本社前で撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria（ロイター） [２５日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・レーティングは２５日、米半導体大手エヌビディアの信用格付けを、引き下げ方向で見直し中の「クレジット・ウオッチ・ネガティブ」に指定した。経営とガバナンス（企業統治）を巡るリスクの高まりを理由に挙げた。

Ｓ＆Ｐは、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の退任とその後の復帰を巡っても、経営幹部の行動規範に対する取締役会の監督に関する懸念は解消されていないと指摘。

今回の問題でエヌビディアの経営・ガバナンス体制、とりわけ取締役会の構造、構成、有効性に関する脆弱性が露呈したと述べた。

エヌビディアの現在の格付けは「ＡＡ」で、これは財務上の債務を履行する能力が極めて高いことを示す。最上位の格付けは「ＡＡＡ」。

Ｓ＆Ｐは、調査やその他の情報開示によって同社の評判や将来の事業見通しに悪影響が及ばない限り、エヌビディアに対する格下げは１段階にとどまると見込んでいる。

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO slide fuels fresh concerns over AI valuations; 37 stocks decline despite positive earnings multiples
item.description: Anthropic’s fall below its IPO price has intensified concerns over lofty AI valuations, even as earnings forecasts improve across the technology sector. Investors are increasingly focused on whether heavy spending can translate into durable profits.
item.dc:creator: ETMarkets.com
item.content:encoded: Anthropic shares dropping below its initial public offering price has intensified investor scrutiny of high technology valuations, as markets question whether even the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom can generate enough profit to justify their share prices, Reuters reported.Shares of the Claude developer were trading near $80.50, below their $83 offer price and nearly 30% below their November 19 opening price.The swift reversal reflects growing unease over how much investors are willing to pay for future growth, even as earnings prospects improve for many companies benefiting from artificial intelligence.For live updates on US Markets, click hereOf the 86 Nasdaq-100 companies with positive earnings multiples and available revision data, 60 saw their forward 12-month earnings forecasts rise over the past three months, according to a Reuters analysis of LSEG data. Yet shares of 37 of those companies declined over the same period.Nvidia shares have fallen about 25% over the past three months despite a nearly 20% increase in earnings forecasts. Marvell Technology and Lumentum have each lost more than 40% of their market value, even as earnings estimates rose 15% and 20%, respectively.High expectationsDespite the selloff, valuation premiums remain substantial.The 25 most highly valued Nasdaq-100 companies, many with exposure to AI, autonomous driving and other emerging technologies, traded at a median 38 times projected earnings for the next 12 months. That compares with 18 times for the remaining companies with positive earnings multiples, Reuters calculations showed.Anthropic illustrates how much future growth is already reflected in technology valuations. Morningstar’s $92-per-share fair value estimate, just 12% above Anthropic’s latest closing price, assumes annual revenue will rise nearly sevenfold over the next five years.Morningstar’s estimates range from $25 to $188 a share under different scenarios, highlighting the sensitivity of Anthropic’s valuation to assumptions about future growth and profitability.The reassessment has been uneven across the sector. Forward price-to-earnings multiples for cybersecurity firms Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks rose the most over the past three months, climbing 11.5% and 10.8%, respectively. Multiples for Sandisk, Nvidia, Intuit and Analog Devices contracted the most, falling between 15% and 26%, LSEG data showed.Also Read: AI credit fears drive CoreWeave, Nvidia risk gauges to record highs“Investors pay up for earnings they believe will last and discount those they think will fade,” said Christopher Gannatti, global head of research at WisdomTree, according to Reuters.Gannatti contrasted Palantir’s high valuation with memory-chip maker Micron’s much lower multiple, arguing that high memory prices could spur additional supply and eventually weigh on prices and profits. Palantir trades at 65 times forward earnings, compared with 3.5 times for Micron, according to LSEG data.Growth spending adds to profit risksThe spending needed to deliver the growth implied by these valuations is another risk to future profitability.CoreWeave reported a 168% rise in third-quarter revenue to $3.66 billion and a contracted revenue backlog of $132.5 billion. Yet the AI computing provider recorded a net loss of $709 million and expects capital spending of $37 billion to $39 billion this year.“Technological breakthroughs don’t automatically translate into attractive returns on capital,” said Troy Hooper, co-head of equity capital markets for the Americas at Mergermarket, according to Reuters. “A year ago, investors were paying a much bigger premium for the promise of AI. Today, they’re getting more tangible evidence of that promise and are seeking stronger profits.”Hooper said increased competition could lower AI prices for customers, hurting companies investing heavily in the technology. Willis Tsai, head of global equities at Nuveen, said rising depreciation charges on AI chips and servers could pressure cloud companies’ margins even as demand for computing capacity grows.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

Nov 25 : Pakistan International Airlines will move its UK operations to its own Boeing 777 fleet from November 26 after wet-lease partner Norse Atlantic Airways abruptly suspended operations, forcing the cancellation of two flights, the Pakistani carrier said on Wednesday. PIA said flights PK 786 from London Heathrow to Islamabad and PK 710 from Manchester to Lahore were cancelled after Norse Atlantic notified the airline of the suspension without prior warning as passengers were preparing to board.

item.title: 米景気は緩やかな拡大続く、インフレ高止まり＝地区連銀報告
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２５日公表した地区連銀経済報告（ベージュブック）によると、経済活動...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米景気は緩やかな拡大続く、インフレ高止まり＝地区連銀報告 4:25 配信

2025年9月17日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）。REUTERS/Ken Cedeno/File Photo（ロイター） [２５日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２５日公表した地区連銀経済報告（ベージュブック）によると、経済活動は大半の地区で「小幅から緩やかな」ペースで拡大を続け、雇用も増加した。一方、インフレ圧力は根強く残った。

物価は「前回の報告期間と同様、全体として緩やかに上昇した」とし、「幅広い業種の調査先から、エネルギー、輸送、医療、保険、関税関連の費用による持続的なコスト圧力が報告された」と説明した。

また、投入コストの上昇が販売価格の上昇を上回っており、企業の利益率への圧力が強まっていることを示唆した。「競争圧力と顧客の価格に対する敏感さが、コスト上昇を全面的に転嫁する企業の能力を制限した。企業は、費用と価格がともに今後数カ月間上昇を続けると予想した」という。

全米の全体像はまちまちで、８地区が成長を報告した一方、４地区は活動が横ばいとした。人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームに主導された設備投資は引き続き堅調だったが、家計の余裕が一段と乏しくなり、より安価な商品への切り替えが進んだため、個人消費は横ばいだった。

ミネアポリス連銀は「ミシガン州北部の業務用家具業者は『顧客は今、より低価格の商品に目を向けている』と話した。ミネソタ州北西部の酒類小売店も『客数の伸びほど売上高は伸びておらず、消費者がより安価な商品に切り替えていることがうかがえる』と述べた」と報告した。

クリーブランド連銀は、活況を呈するＡＩ関連活動の継続的な影響を指摘した。「製造品需要は力強く増加し、その勢いは依然としてデータセンターの建設、発電、防衛に集中している。旺盛なデータセンター需要が半導体や電気部品の供給を逼迫（ひっぱく）させ、納期の長期化を招き、一部の顧客は在庫を確保するため大幅に前倒しで発注した」と述べた。

フィラデルフィア連銀は「小売業者（自動車を除く）からは、１０月下旬から１１月上旬の個人消費が、前回報告期間の小幅減少から一転して小幅に増加したとの報告があった。企業はこうしたセンチメントの改善を、ガソリン価格の低下と選挙の決着によるものだとした」という。

今回のベージュブックは、１１月１６日までに得られた回答を反映した。インフレと生活費負担に対する有権者の懸念が争点となった米中間選挙の前後の数週間を対象とした初めての報告書となった。中間選挙では民主党が上下両院の支配を奪還し、トランプ政権の政策に対する厳しい評価が浮き彫りとなった。ベージュブックの中で、中間選挙には約１２回の言及があった。

ＦＲＢは１２月８─９日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決めると広く予想されている。ただ、ＡＩブームの持続性への懸念から株価が急落し、市場の利上げ観測は後退した。
