Nov 25 (Reuters) – At least 30 people were killed and 15 injured when a vehicle carrying petroleum products overturned and caught fire on a major ring road in Egypt, the health ministry said on Wednesday.

The ring road connects key highways across Greater Cairo, linking the governorates of Cairo, Giza and Qalyubia.

The fire broke out above a tunnel in Giza’s Al-Warraq district, the ministry said. Local media reported that firefighters had brought the blaze under control.

Show Full Article

Road accidents are common in Egypt due to factors including speeding, weak enforcement of traffic regulations and poor road conditions.

In recent years, Egypt has expanded its road network with new highways and bridges under a broader infrastructure programme aimed at easing congestion and accommodating rapid population growth and urban expansion. While the projects have improved traffic flow in some areas, concerns over road safety persist.

(Reporting by Yomna Ehab and Enas Alashray. Editing by Timothy Heritage and Mark Potter)

FAST

PRETORIA, Nov 25 : South Africa coach Shukri Conrad said they still have questions to settle around their batting line-up, even after series wins over Australia and Bangladesh in the last six weeks, as they turn their focus to a three-test home series against England. South Africa beat Bangladesh by an innings and 219 runs on Wednesday to sweep the series 2-0 and sit at the top of the World Test Championship standings, on course for a place in next year’s final. They have not, however, won a home series against England since 2000, which Conrad said would be a test of character. “International cricket is about pressure and we're reaching, arguably, the crescendo of our summer, when the Barmy Army arrives in a few weeks’ time," he said.

“Character is a big thing for us and who do we think will stand up to the English threat on the field, and possibly what they’re going to bring off the field as well, because it's going to be massive for us. We haven't beaten England in many years.” The three-test series against England starts at the Wanderers in Johannesburg on December 17, before tests at Centurion in Pretoria and Newlands in Cape Town. “Obviously, there are a couple of things that we need to consider. I'd like to assume that (captain) Temba (Bavuma) is going to be fit for the first test. He automatically comes in, and then there's a conversation around that number five spot.   "But I did say that I want to bring stability to this batting lineup. I don't want guys to feel that every time they walk out there, it's like an audition that they're going to. That's not the intention, and certainly not the case.” South Africa changed their top order in the 2-1 series win over Australia and again for the Bangladesh tests, where Bavuma's calf injury kept him out of the last encounter. Conrad said the players would now be given time off and would not be expected to go back to their provinces for four-day matches before England arrive. “It feels like we’ve been involved in a five-test series over the last months and you could see, you could sense that the intensity was flagging a bit, the energies weren't as high as they should be. “But we were able to muster and dig deep when we needed to, and obviously pull through. But now everybody's going to get a break.  “And if anyone is under the microscope, no one innings is going to change that. It's either the right guy or not the right guy. We'll obviously talk around certain big personalities, and hopefully we will make the right (selection) decisions," he added.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米司法省、エヌビディアのフアンＣＥＯ復帰前に正式捜査せず＝関係筋
item.description: Dan Rosenzweig-Ziff Erin Banco Jonathan Landay Andrew Goudsw...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米司法省、エヌビディアのフアンＣＥＯ復帰前に正式捜査せず＝関係筋 3:36 配信

2026年11月23日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Dan Rosenzweig-Ziff　Erin Banco　Jonathan Landay　Andrew Goudsward

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -  米司法省が、トランプ米大統領が今週、半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン氏の最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）復帰を後押しする前に、同氏に対する正式な捜査を実施していなかったことが分かった。事情に詳しい３人が明らかにした。

司法省はエヌビディアの顧客企業に対する捜査を進めていたものの、フアン氏本人への正式捜査には着手していなかった。 同氏には中国情報機関とつながりのある女性との不倫疑惑が浮上していた。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた関係者によると、ブランチ米司法長官は、エヌビディアの顧客であるスーパー・マイクロ・コンピューターとメガスピード・インターナショナルに対する司法省の捜査を基に、フアン氏が法律に違反した証拠はないと判断した。両社には先端半導体を中国に密輸した疑いがある。

この判断は捜査の進展に伴って変わる可能性がある。ただ、関係者のうち２人によると、ブランチ氏が週末にトランプ氏とバンス副大統領に対し、フアン氏が国家安全保障上のリスクをもたらす証拠は持っていないと伝える決断を下す上で、決定的な役割を果たした。

フアン氏の復帰には、共和、民主両党の議員から反発が出ている。トランプ氏の介入に先立ち、同社やフアン氏の関与をさらに調べる取り組みがなかったことは、議会で追加調査を求める動きを強めそうだ。フアン氏は来週、議会で証言する予定。

関係者２人によると、エヌビディアの顧客企業に対する司法省の捜査では、フアン氏が中国の工作員として活動したり、機微な半導体技術や情報を承知の上で中国に移転したりした証拠は見つからなかった。エヌビディアは捜査対象ではなく、書類やその他のデータの提供、聴取への対応などで協力し、こうした結論につながったという。

フアン氏本人に対する防諜捜査も行われなかった。事情を知る別の関係者２人によると、米情報機関は、メガスピードの元幹部でフアン氏の不倫相手とされるアリス・フアン氏に関する情報を収集してきた。同氏には中国情報機関に協力していた疑いがある。ただ、米国はエヌビディアのＣＥＯに対する捜査を正当化する具体的な情報を持っていなかったという。

防諜捜査は刑事捜査とは別に行われ、起訴に向けた立件ではなく、国家安全保障上の脅威を監視し、無力化することを目的とする。

事情に詳しい関係者２人によると、司法省当局者はエヌビディアとフアン氏に不正行為はなかったと結論付け、同氏が国家安全保障上のリスクをもたらすとは疑っていなかった。

トランプ氏が２３日のＣＮＢＣのインタビューで説明したところによると、同氏とバンス氏がこの結論をエヌビディアの取締役会に伝え、取締役会はフアン氏の復帰を決めた。

＜「良き企業市民」＞

フアン氏は、アリス・フアン氏と少なくとも２人の従業員との不倫疑惑を受け、１１月１２日にエヌビディアのＣＥＯを辞任した。フアン氏は複数の不倫を認めたが、アリス・フアン氏との関係については明確に認めていない。ロイターはアリス・フアン氏と連絡が取れず、中国情報機関とのつながりも確認できていない。

米紙ニューヨーク・タイムズによると、ルビオ国務長官は５月、この不倫関係についてトランプ氏に説明した。同紙はまた、アリス・フアン氏が不倫関係にあった時期に、１年以上にわたり中国情報機関の高官と連絡を取っていたと報じた。

ブランチ氏はフアン氏の辞任後、同氏がスパイと不倫関係にあったとの報道についてＦＢＩが「調べている」と述べたが、結論には至っていないとしていた。

ブランチ氏は２４日の記者会見で、トランプ政権がどのようにしてフアン氏は米国の国家安全保障上の脅威ではないと判断したのかという質問に、繰り返し回答を控えた。

同氏は、エヌビディアが不正行為に関与した証拠は見つかっていないとした上で、「エヌビディアは良き企業市民ではないという理由は何もない」と語った。

司法省はフアン氏の私生活上の行動とは別に、エヌビディアの事業上の取引について、反トラスト法（独占禁止法）に基づく審査も進めている。

＜スパイ活動への注意喚起＞

専門家は、連邦当局者が通常の防諜手続きを省略したと指摘した。

元中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）職員で、国家安全保障当局の元職員らでつくる団体「ザ・ステディー・ステート」を率いるスティーブ・キャッシュ氏は「国家安全保障に関する疑惑について、司法省が正式に捜査したとの報道はない。驚くことではないにせよ、憂慮すべきことだ」と述べた。

事情を知る法執行当局者によると、ＦＢＩはエヌビディア経営陣に対し、中国のスパイ活動の手口について少なくとも２回、被害防止のための説明を行った。

これらの説明が行われたことは、これまで報じられていなかった。米国の大手テクノロジー企業に日常的に行われる通常の安全対策の一環だったのか、アリス・フアン氏がもたらす脅威に特に焦点を当てたものだったのかは不明。フアン氏本人が説明を受けたかどうかも明らかではない。

法執行機関の元高官２人はロイターに対し、連邦当局者が米企業にスパイ活動のリスクについて幅広く警告することは珍しくないと述べた。

ＣＩＡの元秘密工作員、ケビン・キャロル氏によると、こうした説明での警告が無視された場合、刑事捜査につながることもあるが、主な目的は国家安全保障を守ることにある。

item.content:encoded:
News / Stock Story / Zevia, Bunge Global, and Coca-Cola Consolidated shares skyrocket, what you need to know

Zevia, Bunge Global, and Coca-Cola Consolidated shares skyrocket, what you need to know 3 min read

BG

What happened? A number of stocks rose in the afternoon session after third-quarter 2026 U.S. economic growth accelerated, October 2026 personal income rose and weekly unemployment claims declined. The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) reported in its second estimate that real gross domestic product (GDP) increased at an annual rate of 4.3% in the third quarter of 2026, up from 2.2% in the second quarter of 2026. In a separate release, the BEA reported that personal income increased $201.8 billion, or 0.7% at a monthly rate, in October 2026, while disposable personal income rose $200.5 billion, or 0.8%. Personal consumption expenditures (PCE) increased $63.8 billion, or 0.3%, reflecting increases of $11.8 billion in spending on goods and $52.1 billion in spending on services. The U.S. Department of Labor reported that seasonally adjusted initial unemployment claims fell by 13,000 to 189,000 in the week ending November 21, 2026, from the previous week's revised level of 202,000. The release also showed that the 4-week moving average decreased by 1,500 to 196,000. Stronger economic growth, rising income and low unemployment claims can support household budgets and demand for everyday goods. Share prices of consumer staples companies often rise when investors expect steady consumer spending. The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks. Among others, the following stocks were impacted: Ingredients, flavors & fragrances company Bunge Global jumped 5.8%. Is now the time to buy Bunge Global? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free. Beverages, alcohol, and tobacco company Coca-Cola Consolidated jumped 5.2%. Zooming in on Bunge Global Bunge Global’s shares are not very volatile and have only had 4 moves greater than 5% over the last year. In that context, today’s move indicates the market considers this news meaningful, although it might not be something that would fundamentally change its perception of the business. The biggest move we wrote about over the last year was 3 months ago when the stock dropped 3.3% on the news that national cattle shortages and volatile livestock prices squeezed operating margins and prompted outlook cuts across the food production industry. The historic U.S. cattle shortage, which has pushed herd sizes to a 75-year low following years of severe Western drought, has drastically elevated procurement costs for meatpackers, according to Reuters. This persistent imbalance was highlighted when industry leader Tyson Foods cut its fiscal 2026 adjusted operating income outlook to a range of $2.1 billion to $2.3 billion, down $100 million from its previous forecast, due to worsening beef-segment losses. Tyson projected its full-year adjusted operating loss for the beef business will widen to between $500 million and $650 million, up from its prior estimate of a $350 million to $500 million loss, the company said in its latest financial disclosures. To mitigate these supply-chain headwinds and restructure its beef network, Tyson announced it is closing processing facilities in Joslin, Illinois, and Eagle Mountain, Utah, while pursuing a sale of its Pasco, Washington plant, according to the Wall Street Journal. These closures follow the shutdown of a massive plant in Lexington, Nebraska earlier this year, collectively resulting in thousands of sector lay-offs. Despite plans by the Trump administration to lift a ban on Mexican cattle imports, chief operating officer Wes Morris noted on an earnings call that it will take up to a year for the industry to benefit, as imported feeder cattle must spend time grazing and fattening before slaughter. Bunge Global is down 3.7% since the beginning of the year, and at $89.26 per share, it is trading 32.1% below its 52-week high of $131.41 from June 2026. Investors who bought $1,000 worth of Bunge Global’s shares 5 years ago would now be looking at only $986.49. ALSO WORTH WATCHING: Nvidia’s Quiet Partner. Nvidia’s chips cost a hundred grand. The connectors that make them work cost even more. One company makes them all. Every AI server needs specialized infrastructure the chip companies don’t make. High-speed cables. Power connectors. Thermal sensors. This 90-year-old company built a monopoly on it. The AI boom just started. This stock is still flying under the radar.

item.title: 独首相、ウクライナ支援への理解求める ロの脅威強調
item.description:
Maria Martinez
[ベルリン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Maria Martinez

[ベルリン ２５日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は２５日、連邦議会（下院）での予算案審議で、ロシアが欧州の安全保障への脅威を高めているとして、防衛費増額のほか、侵攻を受けるウクライナへの財政支援継続への理解を求めた。

メルツ氏は「ロシアが求めているのはウクライナだけにとどまらない」とし、「バルト海沿岸地域やポーランド、黒海、宇宙空間に加え、ドイツでも大きく緊張を高めている」と指摘。ウクライナへの支援は技術的な知見を高める意味でもドイツの防衛につながると述べた。

２０２２年のロシアによる侵攻開始以来、ドイツは欧州最大の対ウクライナ軍事支援国となってきた。ただ、今月２４日公表の世論調査によると、生活費高騰を背景に軍事支援に反対する割合が半数をわずかに上回った。極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」や極左政党などの野党は、軍事支援の停止を求めている。

２７年予算案では、３０年までに防衛費を２０００億ユーロ（２２８０億ドル）超に倍増し、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）への公約通り、国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比３．７％とすることを目指している。

一方、ロシアはＮＡＴＯ加盟国への軍事衝突は望んでおらず、ウクライナとの戦闘はロシアの国家安全保障を守るためものだと主張している。

New images reveal crater on asteroid struck by DART spacecraft

The asteroid Dimorphos, in orbit around the asteroid Didymos, with a crater caused by the 2022 impact by the DART spacecraft visible, as seen by a camera aboard the European Space Agency's Hera robotic spacecraft from a distance of 29 km, in this image taken on November 7, 2026. FAST

Nov 25 : Dimorphos, the small asteroid struck by NASA's DART spacecraft in 2022 in the first test of a planetary defense system, was left with one side flattened with a stadium-sized crater and is tumbling in space, as shown by images taken by the European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft released on Wednesday. DART was sent on a proof-of-principle mission for using a spacecraft to change a celestial object's trajectory. Dimorphos, an oblong-shaped rocky object about 495 feet (151 meters) wide, orbits its companion asteroid Didymos, with a diameter of 2,395 feet (730 meters), and the pair is currently about 120 million miles (193.5 million km) from Earth. They are defined as near-Earth asteroids, though neither object imperils Earth. Previous data showed how DART succeeded in changing the path of Dimorphos — demonstrating that a spacecraft could alter the trajectory of an object headed toward a collision with Earth. Hera is now getting a close-up look at how DART physically changed Dimorphos. "The side impacted is now completely covered by a crater, with the visual impression that a piece of the asteroid was cut off by the impact. We do not see evidence for major changes on the site opposite to the DART impact. The combination of those two observations is surprising," Michael Kueppers, ESA's Hera mission scientist, told Reuters.

The big crater covers nearly the whole front side of Dimorphos as it continues its orbit of Didymos.  "Dimorphos is now tumbling in a chaotic way. There are hundreds of boulders floating around in the system," Kueppers said. Hera, about the size of a small car, is presently observing Didymos and Dimorphos from a distance of about 15 to 19 miles (25 to 30 km). Hera next month is slated to approach within 8 miles (13 km) of the pair, obtaining increasingly higher-resolution images.  In January, Hera is due to deploy two shoebox-sized miniature satellites, called CubeSats, that will approach even closer for further study, including investigating the interior structure of the two asteroids. Hera's mission manager unveiled the new images at a dinosaur hall in the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin as a reminder of the danger of asteroid impacts like the one 66 million years ago that caused a mass extinction on Earth and doomed the dinosaurs. The DART, short for Double Asteroid Redirection Test, spacecraft collided with Dimorphos on September 26, 2022, at about 14,000 miles per hour (22,530 kph). "We knew that the DART mission impacted Dimorphos successfully and that it changed its orbit. But we did not know what happened to Dimorphos itself. The investigation of what the impact did to Dimorphos and the characterization of it in general is needed to be able to apply the kinetic impactor technique to another asteroid, should we find one on a collision course with Earth," Kueppers said.

Source: Reuters

item.description: MRVL shares fell 8.47% to $120.43 at 9:40 a.m. ET on November 25 in regular-session trading, as chipmakers led the market lower on persistent selling in AI-linked names and new U.S. tariff proposals.
item.content:encoded:
News / GuruFocus / Marvell Technology Stocks Fall 8.47% as Data Center Exposure Bites

Marvell Technology Stocks Fall 8.47% as Data Center Exposure Bites Less than 1 min read

MRVL Marvell Technology MRVL shares fell 8.47% to $120.43 at 9:40 a.m. ET on November 25 in regular-session trading, as chipmakers led the market lower on persistent selling in AI-linked names and new U.S. tariff proposals. Marvell was down 6.6% before the open and fell further once regular trading began. The data infrastructure chipmaker is heavily tied to the AI build-out. Second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue rose 37% to $2.74 billion, and data center revenue grew 46% to $2.17 billion, about 79% of total sales. Marvell guided third-quarter revenue to $3.15 billion, plus or minus 5%, with non-GAAP EPS of $1.10.

That guide implies about 15% sequential growth, but heavy data center concentration means any pause in hyperscaler spending lands directly on Marvell's top line. The GuruFocus chart shows a GF Score of 85/100: strong momentum and a solid balance sheet, held back by an average profitability rank. GuruFocus puts GF Value at $129.91, a 7.3% discount, and calls the shares fairly valued, so the drop has not created a deep margin of safety. The next test is the third-quarter report: whether Marvell hits the $3.15 billion guide and what it signals for custom AI chips in fiscal 2028.

item.title: India Approves $1.2 Billion Plan to Cut Reliance on Chinese Construction Equipment
item.description: By Nikunj Ohri and Shubham Batra India approved a $1.2 billion incentive plan on Wednesday to boost domestic production of advanced construction equipment and curb its dependence on Chinese imports after Beijing imposed export controls on key machinery. India relies heavily on imported tunnel boring …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
By Nikunj Ohri and Shubham Batra

India approved a $1.2 billion incentive plan on Wednesday to boost domestic production of advanced construction equipment and curb its dependence on Chinese imports after Beijing imposed export controls on key machinery.

India relies heavily on imported tunnel boring machines, with China among the key suppliers of tunneling and other boring equipment used in metro rail and highway construction.

Valued at $10.5 billion, India’s construction and infrastructure equipment market is the world’s third-largest, with 45% of demand met through imports, Information Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw told reporters.

Reuters previously reported that the incentive plan was designed after assessing the incentives required to make local production viable against the country’s existing import dependence.

The new eight-year plan will provide sales-linked incentives to original equipment manufacturers like JCB, Caterpillar, and Hitachi, among others, and component manufacturers including small businesses, Vaishnaw said. It will also provide grants for testing equipment.

The plan will cover seven categories of equipment, including tunnel boring machines, excavators, and drilling machines, as well as five component categories, including engines and transmission systems, he said.

The plan has been in the works for months, but gained urgency after China announced export controls on tunnel boring machines, effective from November 18, prompting India to step up efforts to build the equipment domestically.

The incentive program will attract investments of 210 billion rupees ($2.27 billion) and lead to import substitution worth 225 billion rupees, helping India become self-reliant, Vaishnaw said.

BOLOGNA, Italy, Nov 25 : Lorenzo Musetti marked his return to Davis Cup action with a 6-0 7-6(5) victory over Hong Seong-chan on Wednesday to give three-times defending champions Italy a 1-0 lead over South Korea in the quarter-finals in Bologna. Playing his first Davis Cup match since 2024, the 24-year-old has slipped to 27th in the world rankings after an injury-hit 2026 season that followed a rise to a career-high world number five in January. Musetti skipped last year's Davis Cup Finals, citing physical and family reasons. The Italian raced through the opening set without dropping a game and appeared on course for a routine victory after moving 4-2 ahead in the second. Hong battled back to force a tiebreak, but Musetti held firm to complete the win in one hour and 32 minutes.

FAST

LONDON, Nov 25 : Renault-owned Alpine and Williams broke the Formula One cost cap rules for the 2025 season but both have resolved matters with the latter team handed a penalty, the governing FIA said on Wednesday. The International Automobile Federation said its Cost Cap Administration (CCA) had found Williams committed a minor overspend and procedural breach while a procedural breach was identified for Alpine. "The breaches identified were resolved with Accepted Breach Agreements," the FIA added. Williams said it had unintentionally exceeded the cap by 627,000 pounds ($821,000), equivalent to 0.48 per cent over the allowed amount, with the breach related to administrative costs incurred in changing the company structure which it believed fell outside the cap.

The former champions said they had not sought or gained any sporting advantage but a financial penalty - amount undisclosed - had been imposed along with a 1.5 per cent reduction in wind tunnel and CFD (computational fluid dynamics) testing over the next 12 months. The nine other teams, including newcomers Cadillac who debuted this year, were found to be in compliance with the cap. All five power unit manufacturers were also in compliance. Alpine said in a statement that they accepted the findings. "The team accepts that it unknowingly committed a procedural breach which is a result of inaccuracies in the full year reporting documentation for costs related to exclusions and adjustments," they said. "The errors and inaccuracies in the reporting were specifically related to non-sporting and operational costs which the CCA recognised didn't give the team any performance advantage." Several teams have exceeded the cost cap since it was introduced in 2021 to limit spending and create a more level playing field.  ($1 = 0.7639 pounds)

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 25 : The Federal Communications Commission is authorizing Elon Musk's SpaceX to deploy a constellation of 1 million satellites for data centers in space, the agency said on Wednesday. SpaceX earlier this year sought permission to deploy up to 1 million orbital compute modules to process massive amounts of data to be used on Earth. The FCC said it was approving the SpaceX “Starmind” constellation to help meet rapidly growing demand for AI computing. Under the license, SpaceX must begin deployment no later than November 2033, deploy 10 per cent of the maximum number — or 100,000 — no later than November 2035 and deploy 50 per cent by November 2038, the FCC said. Approving the application will permit SpaceX "to pioneer emergent technology that advances American leadership in space and artificial intelligence," the FCC added.

Data centers are the physical backbone of artificial intelligence, requiring massive amounts of power. "By directly harnessing near-constant solar power with little operating or maintenance costs, these satellites will achieve transformative cost and energy efficiency while significantly reducing the environmental impact associated with terrestrial data centers," SpaceX told the FCC. It was unclear whether SpaceX would put 1 million satellites in space, where only 17,000 satellites exist currently. Satellite operators sometimes request approval for higher numbers of satellites than they intend to deploy to buy design flexibility. SpaceX sought approval for 42,000 Starlink satellites before it began deployment of that system. The growing network currently has just over 11,000 satellites in space. SpaceX's request bets heavily on reduced costs of Starship, the company's next-generation reusable rocket under development, to help deploy satellites. Amazon's rival satellite unit Leo and others have criticized the plan, suggesting SpaceX was unlikely to deploy all the satellites and that it could take centuries to do so. FCC Chair Brendan Carr rejected that criticism in March. "Amazon should focus on getting Amazon's house in order with their own launches and their own satellite constellation, rather than worrying about other people that are actually out there launching satellites at the pace and cadence that SpaceX is," Carr said. The FCC said it was also approving SpaceX's requests to back up its optical network by approving additional communications.

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK: The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq retreated on Wednesday (Nov 25) amid a tech selloff, but finished well off the day's lows as bargain hunters stepped in ahead of the US Thanksgiving holiday. The Dow finished higher. The Nasdaq had been more than 4 per cent lower earlier in the session as the selloff in AI-related stocks and new US tariff proposals hit sentiment. "There are all these potential headwinds, but then there's also a certain amount of conditioning of buying on the dip, and that's part of what we're seeing," said Oliver Pursche, senior vice president and adviser for Wealthspire Advisors in Westport, Connecticut.

"The broad selloffs tend to kind of throw the baby out with the bathwater. Investors are taking advantage of some of those discrepancies," he said. Technology led declines among S&P 500 sectors, while materials and real estate were among top sector gainers. Wall Street has been roiled this month, partly because of worries about AI leader Nvidia. Jensen Huang resigned as CEO earlier this month, but the company's board reinstated him on Monday. The S&P 500 is down roughly 5 per cent for the month. Volume was lower than average ahead of the holiday. The market will be closed on Thursday and will close early on Friday. According to preliminary data, the S&P 500 lost 18.01 points, or 0.25 per cent, to end at 7,183.08 points, while the Nasdaq Composite lost 154.10 points, or 0.65 per cent, to 23,579.44. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 155.20 points, or 0.31 per cent, to 50,173.90. AI WORRIES WEIGH ON MARKET Nvidia shares fell along with an index of semiconductors as the tech selloff deepened. Fears of increased regulatory scrutiny of the AI sector following the Democratic sweep in the US midterm elections have added to worries about AI stocks . Early in the day, the Nasdaq 100 briefly fell 20 per cent from its record closing high, flirting with bear-market territory. Investors were also digesting news that the US proposed new tariffs on goods from 14 trading partners to combat what it calls structural excess industrial capacity, reviving global trade tensions. Data showed the US economy grew much faster than initially estimated in the third quarter, while inflation increased further in October, reinforcing expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next month and again in early 2027. The extra tariffs could cloud the outlook for investors grappling with the prospect of interest rates staying higher for longer, as inflation has accelerated and oil prices have risen steadily due to the US-Iran war.

item.title: エヌビディアＣＥＯ不倫相手に中国スパイ指示の証拠なし、米当局が議会に説明＝米紙
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] - 米当局者が議会スタッフに対し、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と不倫...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エヌビディアＣＥＯ不倫相手に中国スパイ指示の証拠なし、米当局が議会に説明＝米紙 1:39 配信

2024年6月2日撮影。台湾・台北で撮影。エヌビディアのフアンCEOとアリス・フアン氏。REUTERS/Ann Wang/File Photo（ロイター） [２５日 ロイター] - 米当局者が議会スタッフに対し、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と不倫関係にあったアリス・フアン氏が、中国の情報機関からスパイ活動を指示された証拠は見つからなかったと説明していたことが分かった。

米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が２５日、事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。

報道によると、中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）、連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）、国家情報長官室（ＯＤＮＩ）、国家安全保障局（ＮＳＡ）の当局者が、上下両院の情報委員会と議会指導部のスタッフに説明した。説明は、トランプ米大統領が今週初め、ジェンスン・フアン氏が国家安全保障上の脅威ではないとエヌビディアに保証し、同氏の復職に道を開いた後に行われた。

問題の発端となったのは、アリス・フアン氏と中国情報機関とのつながりを巡る疑惑や、アリス氏とフアンＣＥＯの関係が、エヌビディア製半導体の中国への横流し疑惑に影響したかどうかという懸念だった。

ＷＳＪによると、当局者は、アリス・フアン氏が不倫関係にあった期間中、中国の情報機関と接触していたと説明した。ただ、重要な情報を提供した形跡は見つからなかったという。現時点の証拠は、両氏が恋愛関係にあった可能性を示唆しているものの、中国による組織的な工作だったことは示していない。ただし、新たな情報によって、この評価が変わる可能性があるという。

エヌビディアと各機関は、ロイターのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。ロイターは報道を独自に確認できていない。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：人民元に内外の圧力、海外は割安批判　国内は元高懸念 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 コラム：安全資産性薄まる金　リスクオフでも買われず アングル：米ナスダック１００、10月に時価総額2兆ドル超消失　ＡＩ巨額投資に厳しい目 アングル：ケネディ暗殺文書「押収」の舞台裏、国家情報長官室がＣＩＡ急襲 11/26(木) 2:38 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ロシア、ウクライナへの外国部隊展開拒否 英元首相の提案に反発 - Reuters
item.description: ロシア、ウクライナへの外国部隊展開拒否 英元首相の提案に反発 Reuters

item.title: ロシア、ウクライナへの外国部隊展開拒否 英元首相の提案に反発
item.description: [モスクワ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ ２５日 ロイター] - ロシアのペスコフ大統領報道官は２５日、ウクライナ領内へのいかなる外国部隊の展開も容認できないと述べ、ジョンソン英元首相が西側諸国の部隊派遣を提案したことに反対する姿勢を示した。

ジョンソン氏は２４日、ウクライナへの支援を「象徴するもの」としての部隊派遣を提案。「有志連合による象徴的な西側の勢力を配置し、前線から遠く離れた場所で後方支援や兵站業務を実施することで、どの国に部隊派遣を要請するかはウクライナが決めることだということをプーチン氏に示すことになる」と述べていた。ウクライナを巡る戦闘については、ロシアがウクライナを再び自らの影響圏に組み込めるかどうかが争点だとの認識を示した。

これについて、ペスコフ氏は記者団に対し「ウクライナ領内へのいかなる外国部隊の展開も、ロシアは絶対に容認できない。これはプーチン大統領を含めて繰り返し表明してきたことだ」と述べた。

ロシア大統領府は、ジョンソン氏が２０２２年にウクライナ和平交渉を妨害したとも主張しており、破壊的な行動だとして非難。ペスコフ氏は「欧州連合（ＥＵ）や欧州諸国から、軍事部隊を派遣する計画に関する発言が繰り返されている」と不快感を示した。

ロシアは、ウクライナに派遣された西側諸国の部隊はロシアの正当な攻撃対象になると繰り返し警告してきた。ロシアのメドベージェフ安全保障会議副議長（前大統領）は２５日のテレグラムへの投稿で、ジョンソン氏を「危険な挑発者」とし、部隊派遣がロシアと北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）間の戦争につながる可能性があることを示唆した。

item.title: 米ＵＳＴＲ代表、半導体対応を擁護 メガスピードの禁輸リスト追加に同意
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - グリア米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）代表は２５日、トランプ政権による半導体の輸出規制の対応を擁護する姿勢を示し、シンガポールに拠点を置くエヌビディアの取引先メガスピードを貿易ブラックリスト（輸出規制リスト）に追加した措置に同意していると述べた。

グリア氏はＣＮＢＣに対し、半導体および輸出規制について、米政権は規制の抜け穴の一部をふさいでいると説明。輸出規制に関しては、経済と国家安全保障のバランスを取る必要があるとの考えを示した。

その上で、トランプ大統領がこの問題の詳細に踏み込む意欲を示していることは幸いなことだと語った。

さらに、エヌビディアは構造的に重要な企業であり、同社がトップの座を確実に維持するようにする必要があると語った。

item.title: ＡＩ関連株下げ止まらず、ナスダック100が1.5兆ドル超消失も
item.description:
Shashwat Chauhan
[２５日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の下げが止まらない。２５日の株式市場...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ関連株下げ止まらず、ナスダック100が1.5兆ドル超消失も 1:16 配信

2026年11月20日、米ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） Shashwat Chauhan

[２５日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の下げが止まらない。２５日の株式市場では、ＡＩインフラ整備費用の急増に見合う収益が得られるかを投資家が見極める中、半導体メーカーやサーバーメーカー、データセンター運営会社が軒並み大幅下落した。

多額の借り入れに頼ることも多い巨額のインフラ投資と、その収益の不確実性への懸念が強まる中、投資家はＡＩ関連企業に高いハードルを課している。業績が期待を下回れば売りを浴びせる一方、予想を上回る業績や見通しの引き上げにも反応は鈍い。

クロスチェック・マネジメントの最高投資責任者、トッド・シェーンバーガー氏は「各社は支出額で互いを上回ろうとしているように見えるが、それに見合う価値があることを示さなければならない。その点について、株式市場は確信が持てないようだ」と述べた。

ハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック１００指数は４．３％下落。このまま取引を終えれば、構成銘柄の時価総額は１日で１兆５０００億ドル超失われる見通しだ。一時、１０月６日に付けた終値の過去最高値からの下落率が２０％に達し、この水準で引ければ弱気相場入りが確認される。

サーバーメーカーのデル・テクノロジーズは２５日、５．７％下落した。通期の売上高と利益の見通しについて今年３度目の上方修正を行い、２５０億ドルの追加自社株買いを承認したものの、売られた。

競合するＡＩサーバーメーカーのＨＰＥは、通期売上高見通しを引き上げたにもかかわらず、２４日に１６．３％急落。２５日も３．２％下落した。同業のスーパー・マイクロは５．４％安となった。

ＡＩ半導体企業アンバレラは２０．９％急落した。第４・四半期の売上高見通しがアナリスト予想を下回った。

「クロード」を開発するアンソロピックは８．２％下落。記録的なナスダック上場からわずか数日で、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）価格の８３ドルを大きく下回って取引されている。

市場全体では、トランプ政権が１４の貿易相手国・地域からの輸入品に新たな関税を課す案を示したことや、１０月の米インフレ率が一段と上昇したことを示す統計も投資家心理の重しとなり、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種指数は約３％下落した。

半導体株にも売り圧力がかかった。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は７．１％下落し、７カ月超ぶりの安値を付けた。６月の過去最高値からの下落率は４３％を超えている。

混乱の中心にあるエヌビディアは８．４％安。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の復帰をきっかけとした上昇は早々に勢いを失い、２４日の６％安に続く下落となった。

エヌビディアは、巨大クラウド事業者「ハイパースケーラー」からＡＩ向けクラウド事業者「ネオクラウド」まで幅広い顧客に半導体を供給しており、ＡＩ関連投資の重要な指標であり続けている。

ＡＩ分野のハイパースケーラー株も総じて下落。オラクル、アルファベット、アマゾン・ドット・コム、メタ・プラットフォームズ、マイクロソフトは２．９─５．５％下落した。

＜ＡＩ投資が債務負担を増大＞

エヌビディアが出資するネオクラウド企業のコアウィーブとネビウス・グループは、それぞれ１０％超下落。アイレン、アプライド・デジタル、コア・サイエンティフィックは６．９─１０．８％下落した。

ＡＩに特化した計算能力を貸し出すネオクラウド事業者は、急速な事業拡大を支える借り入れへの懸念から、１０月以降、売り圧力にさらされている。

今月の中間選挙で民主党が勝利したことも、こうした懸念を強めた。投資家は、ＡＩ規制の強化や建設の障壁増大によってデータセンターの整備が減速する可能性を見極めている。

トレードウェブのデータによると、コアウィーブの２０３１年償還債は、額面１ドル当たりの価格が０．０２ドル近く下落して過去最低水準に迫り、利回りは１８％近くに上昇した。

ハイテク企業の債務不履行に備える保証コストも急上昇。オラクル、アルファベット、スペースＸ、コアウィーブの５年物クレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ）のスプレッドは過去最高水準に達した。

item.content:encoded:

Anthropic's slide tests Wall Street's lofty bets on future AI profits

Anthropic, PBC (ANT) advertisements are displayed in Times Square on the day Anthropic, PBC (ANT) holds their initial public offering (IPO) at the NASDAQ MarketSite in New York City, US, November 19, 2026. REUTERS/Mike Segar

FAST

Nov 25 : Anthropic's slide below its initial public offering price has sharpened investor scrutiny of lofty technology valuations, as markets increasingly question whether even the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom can generate enough profit to justify their price tags. Shares of the Claude developer were trading around $80.50, well below their $83 offer price and nearly 30 per cent below their opening price on November 19. The swift reversal highlights growing unease over how much investors are willing to pay for future growth, even as earnings prospects improve for many companies benefiting from artificial intelligence. Of the 86 Nasdaq-100 companies with positive earnings multiples and available earnings revision data, 60 saw their forward 12-month earnings forecasts rise over the past three months, a Reuters analysis of LSEG data showed. Yet, shares in 37 of those companies declined over the same period.

Nvidia shares have fallen about 25 per cent over the past three months despite a nearly 20 per cent increase in its earnings forecasts, partly driven by the volatile swings around CEO Jensen Huang's abrupt exit and reinstatement, while Marvell Technology and Lumentum have each lost more than 40 per cent of their market value even as earnings estimates rose 15 per cent and 20 per cent, respectively. HIGH EXPECTATIONS Despite the selloff, substantial valuation premiums persist. The 25 most richly valued companies in the Nasdaq-100 — many with exposure to AI, autonomous driving and other emerging technologies — traded at a median of 38 times projected earnings for the next 12 months, compared with 18 times for the remaining companies with positive earnings multiples, Reuters calculations showed. Anthropic illustrates how much future growth is already embedded in technology share prices. Morningstar's fair value estimate of $92 per share, just 12 per cent above Anthropic's latest closing price, assumes its annual revenue will increase nearly sevenfold over the next five years. Morningstar's estimates range from $25 to $188 per share under different scenarios, underscoring how sensitive Anthropic's valuation is to assumptions about future growth and profitability. The reassessment of valuations has been uneven across the tech sector. Forward price-to-earnings multiples for cybersecurity firms Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks rose the most over the past three months, climbing 11.5 per cent and 10.8 per cent, respectively. Multiples for Sandisk, Nvidia, Intuit Inc and Analog Devices contracted the most, falling between 15 per cent and 26 per cent, LSEG data showed. "Investors pay up for earnings they believe will last and discount those they think will fade," said Christopher Gannatti, global head of research at asset manager WisdomTree. Gannatti contrasted Palantir's high valuation with memory-chip maker Micron's much lower multiple, arguing that high memory prices could spur additional supply and eventually depress prices and profits. Palantir trades at 65 times forward earnings, compared with just 3.5 times for Micron, LSEG data showed. THE COST OF GROWTH The cost of delivering the growth implied by these valuations is another threat to future profitability. CoreWeave reported a 168 per cent rise in third-quarter revenue to $3.66 billion and a contracted revenue backlog of $132.5 billion. Yet the AI computing provider recorded a net loss of $709 million and expects capital spending of $37 billion to $39 billion this year. "Technological breakthroughs don't automatically translate into attractive returns on capital," said Troy Hooper, co-head of equity capital markets for the Americas at Mergermarket. "A year ago, investors were paying a much bigger premium for the promise of AI. Today, they're getting more tangible evidence of that promise and are seeking stronger profits." Growing competition could push down AI prices for customers, to the detriment of the companies investing heavily in the technology, Hooper said. Willis Tsai, head of global equities at Nuveen, said rising depreciation charges on AI chips and servers could erode cloud companies' profit margins even as demand for computing capacity grows.

(Reporting By Patturaja Murugaboopathy, Editing by Vidya Ranganathan and Nia Williams)

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米新築住宅販売、10月は14.2％増の70.1万戸 10カ月ぶり高水準
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２５日発表した１０月の新築一戸建て住宅販売戸数（季節調整済み）は年率換...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新築住宅販売、10月は14.2％増の70.1万戸　10カ月ぶり高水準 1:01 配信

7月14日、米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２５日発表した１０月の新築一戸建て住宅販売戸数（季節調整済み）は年率換算で前月比１４．２％増の７０万１０００戸と、２０２５年１２月以来、１０カ月ぶりの高水準となった。建設業者が購入者を呼び込むために価格を引き下げたことで急増したものの、住宅ローン金利の上昇は依然として住宅市場全体の活動を抑える要因となっている。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は６５万戸だった。前年同月比では７．５％増加した。

９月分は６１万４０００戸と、当初発表の６７万６０００戸から下方改定された。

３０年固定住宅ローン金利は、米国とイスラエルが２月末にイランを攻撃して以降、約１３０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇した。住宅金融機関フレディマックのデータによると、先週は平均７．２８％だった。

１０月の販売急増にもかかわらず、新築住宅の在庫は依然として高水準にあり、建設業者が新たな一戸建て住宅プロジェクトに着工する能力を今後も妨げる可能性が高い。

１０月の新築住宅価格の中央値は前年同月比３．２％下落の３９万１３００ドル。１０月に販売された住宅の大半は３９万９９９９ドル以下の価格帯だった。

新築住宅在庫は４７万戸と、前月の４７万７０００戸から減少した。

１０月の販売ペースに基づく在庫の消化期間は８．０カ月と、２０２５年１２月以来の低水準となった。前月は９．３カ月だった。

item.title: ＥＵとスイス、米関税上限15％順守に期待 新措置提案受け
item.description: [ブリュッセル／チューリヒ ２５日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権が通商法３０１条に基づく新たな関税措置を提案したこと...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＵとスイス、米関税上限15％順守に期待　新措置提案受け 0:55 配信

１１月２５日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） [ブリュッセル／チューリヒ　２５日　ロイター] - トランプ米政権が通商法３０１条に基づく新たな関税措置を提案したことを受け、欧州連合（ＥＵ）とスイスは、米国が導入するいかなる措置もこれまでに合意された関税率上限１５％と整合するものになるとの認識を示した。

ＥＵの執行機関である欧州委員会の報道官は、昨年の米ＥＵの関税合意を定めた共同声明で合意された関税率上限１５％に言及した上で、「共同声明に基づき、１５％の包括的な関税上限はＥＵ製品に適用される。今回の調査に基づくいかなる措置も、既存の関税と合わせた場合を含め、この上限を完全に順守すると期待している」と述べた。

また、世界的な過剰生産能力の問題を巡り米欧が共同で行動できていないことに遺憾の意を示し、欧州が構造的な過剰生産能力の発生源になっているとの見方を強く否定した。

スイス経済省も、昨年合意されたスイス製品に対する米関税の上限を１５％とする取り決めと整合するものになるとの認識を示し、合意順守を期待するとした。

スイスの経済団体エコノミースイスも政府と足並みをそろえ、過剰生産能力を巡る米国の主張を否定した上で、関税上限１５％の合意が尊重されるよう要請。米国に対する貿易黒字は主に医薬品と金（ゴールド）の輸出によるもので、産業の過剰生産能力とは無関係との認識を示し、米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）が問題視している鉄鋼、アルミニウム、自動車、電池、太陽光パネル、セメント、船舶、半導体といった分野について「スイスには当てはまらない」とした。

item.content:encoded:
News / Coindar / Axie Infinity to Begin Elite 4 on November 29th

Axie Infinity to Begin Elite 4 on November 29th Less than 1 min read

AXSUSD

Axie Infinity will begin Elite 4 on November 29th as part of Origins Postseason 19. Refer to the official tweet by AXS:

Axie Infinity @AxieInfinity

Welcome to Origins Postseason 19! Congrats to all Lunacians who battled through S19 âš”ï¸ âš”ï¸ Elite 4 starts Nov 29 âš¡ï¸ Morph Tickets coming soon for Elite 4 🏆 Check Collectible Axie Tickets now Full announcement 👇 📜 : https://t.co/LXYVhUGBuO pic.twitter.com/FCjvId92Tm

Nov 25, 2026

AXS Info Axie Infinity is a blockchain game developed by Sky Mavis. The game runs on Ethereum and utilizes non-fungible tokens (NFTs) that represent unique items or characters. At the core of the game are creatures called "Axies," which players can collect, breed, use for battles, and even use for virtual land farming. Each Axie has different attributes and statistics, and players can use their Axies in player-versus-player (PvP) battles or player-versus-environment (PvE) adventures. One of the unique aspects of Axie Infinity is that players can earn digital assets and cryptocurrency while playing the game. This makes Axie Infinity an example of a "play-to-earn" game, where in-game actions can lead to real financial benefits. The AXS token (Axie Infinity Shards) is the native token of Axie Infinity and is used for game governance, participating in voting for game rules, earning rewards, and more.

item.description: [フランクフルト ２５日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の政策担当者は２５日、ユーロ圏の銀行に対する最低準...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ、最低準備率引き上げ協議　12月か27年初めにも決定へ＝関係筋 0:43 配信

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）ビル。2022年12月15日、ドイツ・フランクフルトで撮影。REUTERS/Wolfgang Rattay（ロイター） [フランクフルト ２５日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の政策担当者は２５日、ユーロ圏の銀行に対する最低準備率の引き上げについて協議し、１２月または２０２７年初頭にも決定するとの見通しを示した。協議に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。

関係筋によると、選択肢を提示した事務方は変更に懐疑的だったものの、政策担当者の多くは準備率の単純な引き上げを支持する姿勢を示しており、さらに準備を進めた上で提案が可決される公算が大きいという。

ＥＣＢの広報担当者はコメントを控えた。

item.title: 英インフレピークは予測下回る可能性、エネ価格安定なら＝中銀総裁
item.description: [ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - 英イングランド銀行（中央銀行、ＢＯＥ）のベイリー総裁は２５日、ここ数週間のエネルギー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英インフレピークは予測下回る可能性、エネ価格安定なら＝中銀総裁 0:30 配信

英イングランド銀行のベイリー総裁。11月5日、ロンドンの英中銀本部で撮影。Alishia Abodunde/Pool via REUTERS（ロイター） [ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - 英イングランド銀行（中央銀行、ＢＯＥ）のベイリー総裁は２５日、ここ数週間のエネルギー価格の下落を受けて、国際エネルギー価格が足元の水準で安定すれば、英国のインフレ率は今月初めに公表された予測よりも低い水準で推移する可能性があるとの見方を示した。

英中銀は１１月５日に公表した基本予測で、国内インフレ率は来年半ばに目標の２倍を超える５％前後に達するとの見通しを示していたが、それ以降、原油・ガス価格は下落している。今月に入り、北海ブレント原油先物は約２０％、英国の天然ガス先物は１５％下落した。ただ、２月末の中東での戦争勃発前の水準をなお大幅に上回っている。

ベイリー氏は議会財務委員会で「現在の価格水準が維持されれば、インフレ率のピークは機械的に低くなるだろう」と述べた。同氏は、英経済は最近、一段と底堅さを示しており、労働市場の緩和傾向も止まっているとし、英中銀はこれらをインフレ予想に織り込む必要があるとの考えを表明。その上で、追加利上げの公算が大きいとの見解を改めて示した。

また、ロンバルデリ副総裁は財務委員会で、英中銀は来年、食品価格のインフレ率が５％前後に上昇すると予想していると述べた。最近の賃金データについてはまちまちだと指摘し、直近のインフレデータを踏まえ、基調的なディスインフレ傾向が依然として順調に進んでいるかどうかについて確信が持てなくなっていると述べた。

さらに、金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員は、企業の利益率の圧迫がインフレ抑制に今後も寄与し続けるとは考えていないとし、「最適な対応策は、より大幅に、より早期に利上げすることだ」と述べた。

金利先物市場は、英中銀が８０％の確率で来月に２回目の利上げを実施するとの見方を織り込んでおり、２７年にさらに２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げが２回あると見ている。

item.title: Sensex, Nifty surge nearly 2% to post their best session since November 6
item.description: The Nifty 50 closed 1.65 per cent up at 25,791.25, and the BSE Sensex ended the day 1.88 per cent up at 83,982.08.
item.dc:creator: Shilpa Rangarajan
item.content:encoded: Benchmark indices rebounded sharply on Wednesday to their best session since November 6 — with broader markets, excluding smallcaps, also in the green — as easing commodity prices and rupee appreciation lifted over 80 per cent of index constituents and propelled Hindustan Unilever Ltd (HUL) to its biggest gain since June 2024. Across banks and fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) in the largecap space (top 250 companies), private banks gained ₹1.01 trillion and FMCG makers ₹0.82 trillion, together accounting for nearly 46 per cent of the ₹4 trillion added to the market value of NSE-listed companies, which now stands at ₹507.09 trillion. The Nifty 50 closed 1.85 per cent up at 25,819.25, and the BSE Sensex ended the day 1.82 per cent up at 83,938.28. At current levels and on a closing basis, the Nifty 50 is just 1.9 per cent away from its all-time high of 26,328.6, while the Sensex is 2.2 per cent away from its record high of 85,836.1. Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) bought a net ₹4,479.08 crore, and domestic institutional investors (DIIs) bought a net ₹4,018.72 crore, according to provisional exchange data. Brent crude fell below the $90/barrel mark intraday, and the rupee appreciated 0.7 per cent to 92.24 against the dollar.    FMCG stocks led the gains, with the Nifty FMCG index jumping 3.79 per cent to 50,143.50 as all its constituents closed in the green. The rally was driven by heavyweights HUL and ITC, with the former up 6.08 per cent and the latter rising 2.74 per cent. Nifty Consumer Durables index, meanwhile, slipped 0.13 per cent. “FMCG and pharmaceutical stocks are seeing buying interest because investors are looking for sectors that offer relatively stable earnings and lower business uncertainty amid market volatility. FMCG firms benefit from steady demand for everyday products, while pharma companies are supported by consistent healthcare demand and export opportunities,” said Somil Mehta, head of retail research at Mirae Asset Sharekhan. Of the 44 analysts tracked by Bloomberg, 33 have a “Buy” rating on HUL, nine have a “Hold”, and two have a “Sell”. The consensus target price is ₹2,194.53,  just 2.5 per cent over Wednesday’s price of ₹2,141.80. “HUL’s product portfolio primarily consists of crude oil-linked products such as detergents and soaps. Therefore, when oil corrects, it benefits companies such as HUL,” said Saurav Chaube, research analyst at Samco Securities. “Indian equities are likely to witness a gradual upward move, supported by strong foreign institutional investor (FII) buying, easing crude oil prices, a stronger rupee, and sector-specific momentum,” said Siddhartha Khemka, head of research - wealth management at Motilal Oswal.

item.title: ロシアがウクライナ電力網攻撃、5州で停電 ザポリージャ原発も電源喪失
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２５日 ロイター] - ウクライナ当局は２５日、ロシアが夜間にウクライナの電力網などを攻撃し、エネルギー・ガス関連インフラが損傷したほか、オデーサなど５つの州で停電が発生したと明らかにした。

電力大手ＤＴＥＫによると、ロシアの攻撃で火力発電所の発電が停止し、設備が大きく損傷した。同社は発電所の所在地を明らかにしていない。攻撃はまた、ウクライナ中部ポルタワ州にある国営ガス会社ナフトガスのガス生産施設で大規模な火災を引き起こし、操業が停止した。

全土で厳しい冬の寒さが到来する中、今回の一連の攻撃は、すでに逼迫しているウクライナのエネルギーシステムへの圧力を一段と強めた。

ネクラソフ・エネルギー副大臣によると、今回の攻撃で、ロシアが占拠するザポリージャ原子力発電所の外部電源も遮断された。外部電源の喪失は今年に入って１７回目となる。

item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２５日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期（２６年７─９月期）の国内総生産（Ｇ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＧＤＰ、第3四半期改定値4.3％増　ＡＩ主導で3年ぶり高成長 0:11 配信

2025年11月16日、米ニューヨークのホリデーマーケットで撮影。REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz（ロイター） [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２５日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期（２６年７─９月期）の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）改定値は年率換算で前期比４．３％増だった。速報値の３．４％増から上方修正され、３年ぶりの高い伸びとなった。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は、３．５％増への上方修正だった。第２・四半期は２．２％増だった。

今回の上方修正は、主に人工知能（ＡＩ）に関連する個人消費と設備投資の伸び率が引き上げられたことを反映した。経済全体の３分の２超を占める個人消費の伸びは４．２％増と、速報値の３．８％増から上方修正された。

消費は主に高所得世帯が主導している。これらの世帯の資産は、人工知能（ＡＩ）主導の売り浴びせが始まる前の株式市場によって押し上げられていた。歴史的な低水準の一時解雇（レイオフ）と緩やかな雇用増加も、他の世帯が消費を維持する一助となっているが、賃金の伸びは時にインフレに追いついていない。世帯は貯蓄を減らし、蓄えを取り崩してもいる。

設備投資は２１．８％増と、前月推計された２０．９％増から上方修正された。設備投資は３四半期連続で２桁の伸びを記録しているものの、エコノミストらは、投資家がＡＩの企業価値を精査するにつれて、この傾向が鈍化する可能性があると警告している。

政府支出、貿易、在庫を除く民間国内最終需要は５．８％増と、速報値の４．９％増から上方修正され、２０２１年第２・四半期以来の高い伸びとなった。

第３・四半期の国内生産から生じた企業利益は２０６０億ドル増加。前期は３８４０億ドル増だった。

国内総所得（ＧＤＩ）は４．４％増だった。前期は２．３％増だった。

経済活動を判断する上でより良い指標とされるＧＤＰとＧＤＩの平均は４．４％増だった。前期は２．２％増だった。

item.title: Glencore taps former CEO’s nephew to lead coal unit
item.description: Colin Glasenberg has been working at Glencore since 2011, and his uncle, Ivan Glasenberg led the company for 20 years.
item.dc:creator: Marina Meireles
item.content:encoded:
Glencore taps former CEO’s nephew to lead coal unit  Colin Glasenberg has been working at Glencore since 2011, and his uncle, Ivan Glasenberg led the company for 20 years.

Marina Meireles | November 25, 2026 - 9:43 am

Categories: Coal Europe Top Companies

Ivan Glasenberg, Glencore's former chief executive officer ( Image: Wikipedia )

Glencore (LON: GLEN) has appointed Colin Glasenberg, the nephew of former chief executive officer and the company’s largest shareholder Ivan Glasenberg, to lead its massive coal mining unit.

Colin Glasenberg, who joined the Swiss commodities giant in 2011 and has served as its industrial lead for oil since 2020, succeeds Earl Melamed, who is retiring after three decades with the company.

Mark Power, currently an asset manager in the energy business, is set to replace Glasenberg as head of oil assets, Bloomberg reported.

Glencore produces about 130 million tonnes of coal annually, generating $4.85 billion of adjusted core earnings in 2025. It is the top global coal shipper and is benefitting from coal demand due to the energy and oil crisis caused by geopolitical conflicts, like the closure of the Strait of Hormuz and the Russia-Ukraine war.

Coal demand to rise 1.2% as Hormuz closure drives gas prices: IEA

Ivan Glasenberg was Glencore’s CEO from until his retirement in 2021. Today he holds 10.42% of Glencore’s shares valued at about $8.33 million.

Glencore didn’t provide comments on Glasenberg’s appointment.

Shares in Glencore were down 2% to £432.25 apiece by market close on Wednesday in London, valuing the company at £50.6 billion ($66.2 billion).

(With files from Bloomberg and Reuters)

(Corrects attribution in paragraph 6) Nov 25 : The US Treasury's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network proactively took certain systems offline after a cybersecurity incident resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of the agency's systems, a FinCEN official said on Wednesday. The US Treasury Department is working with the Federal Bureau of Investigation, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency and third-party forensic examiners to determine the scope and impact, according to the official. Outages and disruptions across tech, government and other systems have become a growing concern for governments, companies and the public in recent months, as advanced AI tools make it easier to find vulnerabilities and attack systems.

Several technology failures this month have hit critical US systems, among them a nationwide halt to air travel, a Microsoft outage affecting email services, a glitch at several large banks and a brief disruption to the National Security Agency's network. "As a proactive measure, we have taken certain FinCEN systems offline and provided exceptive relief for filers that are not able to submit reports as a result of the disruption," the official said in a statement. While forensic analysis remains ongoing, there is no evidence of any breach of the Bank Secrecy Act or beneficial ownership databases, a person familiar with the matter said.

Source: Reuters

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米10月コア資本財受注1.2％増、ＡＩ投資過熱警戒で勢い鈍化も 11/25 23:36 配信

2025年2月21日、米国イリノイ州メンドータにある工場。 REUTERS/Vincent Alban（ロイター） [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省センサス局が２５日発表した１０月の耐久財受注は、民間設備投資の先行指標とされるコア資本財（非国防資本財から航空機を除く）の受注が前月比１．２％増加した。出荷も堅調に伸び、企業の設備投資が勢いを維持したことを示唆した。ただ、ＡＩ（人工知能）の企業価値を巡る投資家の警戒が強まっており、この勢いが鈍化する可能性もある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想では、コア資本財受注は０．７％増加すると見込まれていた。

９月は０．８％増に上方修正された。

１０月は前年同月比では１１．２％増加した。

国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計の設備投資（機器）の算出に用いられるコア資本財の出荷は、１０月に０．６％増加した。９月は１．３％増だった。

設備投資（機器）はＡＩへの積極的な投資を追い風に、３四半期連続で２桁の伸びを記録している。ただ、ＡＩの資金調達や収益性、規制、データセンター開発への世論の反発を巡る幅広い疑問が浮上してきている。ハイテク企業はこの１年、ＡＩ投資に向けて巨額の資金を借り入れてきた。

耐久財受注全体は１０月に０．２％増加した。９月は２．０％の大幅増だった。１０月は前年同月比では８．３％増加した。１０月は輸送用機器の受注が０．３％減少したことで全体が抑制された。耐久財はトースターから航空機まで３年以上使われるモノを指す。

項目別の受注は、自動車・部品が０．９％増加した。一方、変動の大きい民間航空機は０．３％減少し、自動車・部品の増加分を上回って全体を押し下げた。米航空機大手ボーイングのウェブサイトによると、１０月の航空機受注数は１６５機で９月と同水準だったが、大半は低価格の７３７ＭＡＸ機だった。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新規失業保険申請1.3万件減の18.9万件、予想以上に減少 11/25 23:26 配信

米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスにある地元企業のドアに掲げられた求人看板。2025年8月1日撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米労働省が２５日発表した１１月２１日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比１万３０００件減の１８万９０００件となった。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想（２０万件）以上に減少し、労働市場の安定を示唆した。

申請件数は７月中旬以降、かなり低い水準で推移している。エコノミストは、労働市場が依然として「低採用・低解雇」の完全雇用の状態にあると見ている。労働市場の安定を受け、インフレ抑制に取り組む連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、１２月に予想される利上げに続いて追加利上げを行う道を開く公算が大きい。

１１月１４日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は９万５０００件減の１６９万７０００件だった。今回の継続受給件数のデータは、１１月の雇用統計の調査期間と重なっている。

今回の統計は、２６日の感謝祭の祝日を控え、通常より１日早く公表された。

item.title: What the PCE Data Means for Fed Policy
item.description: The Federal Reserve’s preferred measure of underlying inflation, the personal consumption expenditures price index excluding food and energy, rose 0.3%. From a year earlier, core PCE was up 3.3%, the most since 2023 — keeping Fed policymakers on track for an interest-rate hike next month. Bloomberg Intelligence's Ira Jersey has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: 米10月ＰＣＥ価格指数、前年比＋3.8％に伸び加速 利上げ観測強まる
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米商務省経済分析局（ＢＥＡ）が２５日発表した１０月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米10月ＰＣＥ価格指数、前年比＋3.8％に伸び加速　利上げ観測強まる 11/25 23:09 配信

8月26日、米ニューヨークの食料品店で撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） [ワシントン　２５日　ロイター] - 米商務省経済分析局（ＢＥＡ）が２５日発表した１０月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．８％上昇し、９月の３．６％上昇から伸びが加速した。これを受け、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が２０２７年初めまで利上げを続けるとの観測が強まった。前年比の伸びはエコノミスト予想と一致した。

前月比では０．３％上昇し、９月の０．５％上昇（改定なし）から伸びが鈍化した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は０．３％上昇だった。

変動の大きい食品・エネルギーを除くコアＰＣＥ価格指数は前年比３．３％上昇し、９月の３．１％上昇から伸びが拡大し、２３年１１月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。前月比では３カ月連続で０．３％上昇となった。

個人消費支出は前月比０．３％増加した。９月は当初発表の０．５％増から０．６％増に上方改定された。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「景気需要を冷やすために、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げペースを加速させることがこれまで以上に喫緊の課題となっている」と指摘。「かつては、輸入関税や中東戦争に伴うエネルギー価格が、インフレ上昇の一時的な要因だと考えられていたが、インフレの火に油を注いでいるのは、昔ながらの経済需要の圧力であるとの見方がますます強まっている」と述べた。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、金融市場は１２月８─９日の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げが実施されるとの見方を織り込んでおり、１月にも追加利上げがあるとみている。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か アングル：インフレで揺らぐ債券のヘッジ機能、米投資家は実物資産に移行 コラム：米重要インフレ指標の乖離拡大、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長にとって頭痛の種に 11/26(木) 2:38 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

GUANGZHOU, Nov 25 : Nio chief executive William Li said on Wednesday the company could raise its gross profit margin by 10 per centage points over the long run as it deploys artificial intelligence across its business units to boost efficiency.  • Ahead of the Guangzhou Auto Show, which will kick off on Friday, Nio said at its technology day in the southern city that it has deployed 7,500 AI agents in areas including research and development, manufacturing, logistics and car sales • Li told reporters that embedding AI into automakers' business operations "will be critical to staying competitive and driving the next wave of transformation" • The Chinese electric vehicle maker also unveiled the third generation of its World Model, which it said would require 40 per cent fewer driver interventions for its advanced driver-assistance system and less computing power to train the technology

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Lawder　Andrea Shalal

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２５日、日本、中国、欧州連合（ＥＵ）を含む１４の貿易相手国・地域に対し、新たな関税措置を提案した。「構造的な過剰生産能力」への対抗措置だと説明した。共和党が中間選挙で敗北した後も保護主義的な姿勢を緩めておらず、世界的な貿易摩擦が再燃する恐れがある。

グリア米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）代表によると、税率は各国が米政権と交渉し合意済みの貿易協定の上限を超えない水準となる。

グリア氏によると、提案された関税措置は来年１月２５日の公聴会を経た後に発効する予定で、米国の製造業基盤を弱体化させる「製造業の集中的育成、賃金・労働条件の抑制、金融支援やその他の支援、非市場経済的な投入要素、その他の市場をゆがめる慣行に基づく産業戦略」に対抗することを目的としている。また、今回提案した関税は「貿易委員会（Board of Trade）」と呼ばれる二国間メカニズムを通じて関税引き下げが検討されている約３００億ドル相当の中国製品輸入には適用されないと説明した。

また、６０の国・地域を対象とした強制労働対策法の執行不備に関する別の米調査に基づき導入された１０％または１２．５％の関税には上乗せされない。また、鉄鋼、アルミニウム、自動車などに課されている分野別の国家安全保障関税にも追加されないという。

＜中国関税率２０％＞

中国に対しては２０％の税率を適用し、第１次トランプ政権時に課した約２５％の関税に上乗せする。ＵＳＴＲは、来年１月１０日に期限を迎える米中の貿易休戦が破綻した場合には、税率を４０％に引き上げるとしている。

米政府は、中国が鉄鋼や電気自動車（ＥＶ）、太陽光関連製品などの低価格な輸出品を大量に世界市場へ供給していると非難。米政府高官は「こうした措置を中国側が好ましく思っていないことは承知しているが、われわれは中国との安定的な関係を求めており、中国もまた米国との安定を模索している」と述べた。今月行われた米中首脳会談は「実に素晴らしいものだった」とも強調した。

在米中国大使館の報道官は「産業の過剰生産能力を巡る問題は実際には存在せず、政治的な操作の口実とされるべきではない」とし、中国が過剰生産能力の源泉であるとの主張を否定。 トランプ大統領と中国の習近平国家主席の間で交わされた合意を双方が着実に履行するよう呼びかけた。ただ、報復措置については言及しなかった。

＜日本、ＥＵなど最大１５％＞

日本、韓国、台湾、ＥＵ、スイスに対する税率は、既存の関税を含めて最大１５％となる。

このほか、カンボジア、インドネシア、マレーシア、タイ、バングラデシュからの輸入品には１８％の関税を課す。ベトナムについては、米国との貿易協定が成立すれば２０％、交渉が決裂した場合は３５％に引き上げる。インドについても、貿易協定が成立すれば１７％、交渉決裂の場合は２５％を課すとした。

シンガポールに対しては上限税率１０％の適用を提案。グリア代表によると、メキシコとノルウェーについては貿易慣行に関する調査が継続中のため、今回の関税提案の対象から除外された。

グリア氏はＣＮＢＣのインタビューに対し、今回提案した関税率の上限は、過去１年間に締結された通商合意と整合的な内容だと説明した。これらの合意は米国製品の輸出障壁引き下げにもつながったとし、「 これらの合意が過剰生産能力を巡りわれわれが直面する多くの問題の解決につながったか、解決に向けて前進させるものと考えているため、 今回の提案でもそうした合意を尊重している」と述べた。その上で、今回示した関税率の上限については、各貿易相手国にとっても想定外の内容ではないとの認識を示した。

ＵＳＴＲはこれとは別に、不公正な貿易慣行とされる問題の是正をブラジル政府に促す取り組みの一環として、ブラジル航空機大手エンブラエルの完成商用機輸入に対し新たに１０％の関税を課す方針示したほか、輸入枠を超過するブラジル産砂糖への関税引き上げを提案。これらの品目は、別の通商法３０１条調査に基づき７月に導入されたブラジル製品への２５％関税の適用除外となっていた。グリア米通商代表は、米国とブラジルの協議が数カ月にわたり「有意義な進展」を見せなかったため、関税引き上げを提案することを決めたとしている。

ＩＮＧのアナリストは、「関税の法的根拠が変化し続ける一方で、米国の保護主義を解消することがますます困難になっていることが改めて示された」との見方を示した。

＜新議会発足後、民主党による関税撤廃は困難か＞

米連邦最高裁が今年２月に国家非常事態法に基づいて導入された同大統領の広範な対世界関税措置を無効とする判断を下したことを受け、 ＵＳＴＲは産業の過剰生産能力を巡る８カ月間の不公正貿易慣行調査の結果を公表することでトランプ政権の関税交渉力の再構築を目指している。

今回の取り組みはまた、司法判断に耐えてきた１９７４年通商法３０１条を根拠とすることで、トランプ政権の関税措置とそれに関連する通商合意を、法的・政治的により強固な基盤の上に置く狙いがある。さらに、共和・民主両党が主要な通商問題とみなしている外国政府の補助金や産業政策にも対処することを目指している。

中間選挙で共和党が敗北したことを受け、来年１月の新議会発足後に上院財政委員長に就任する見通しのワイデン上院議員（民主党、オレゴン州）は「（中間選挙で）有権者がトランプ政権の破滅的な通商政策を否定してから１カ月もたたないうちに、トランプ大統領は再び米国民の負担を増やすことを決めた。トランプ氏の破滅的な関税措置を終わらせるため、財政委員長として利用可能なあらゆる手段を講じる」と述べた。

ただ、ＵＳＴＲ元当局者のネーサニエル・ハルバーソン氏は、中国を主な発生源とする過剰生産能力への対抗については議会内に超党派の支持があり、関税撤廃は容易ではないと指摘。関税を撤廃すれば一部の通商合意が破綻する可能性もあるとし、「民主党は米国の利益に一定程度かなう可能性のある合意を覆したいのか検討を迫られる」と述べた。

Exclusive-UK advances plans for BBC iPlayer expansion to allow advertising and rival content, sources say

FAST

LONDON, Nov 25 : Britain is advancing plans to open up BBC iPlayer to advertising and rival broadcasters, potentially paving the way for an overhaul of the streaming platform, according to two people with knowledge of the matter. The proposal would represent a significant expansion of iPlayer's role as a platform for BBC programmes, with one of the people saying the technology upgrade that would be required could cost tens of millions of pounds. The potential technology investment to allow iPlayer to carry advertising attached to content from rivals including Channel 4 has not been reported previously. It is part of wider efforts among British broadcasters to compete with global streaming services such as Netflix, Disney+ and Amazon Prime Video. The change is expected to feature in a White Paper on the BBC's charter renewal, due by the end of the year, setting out the government's position on the public broadcaster's funding, governance and remit from 2028, the two people said.

The BBC pointed to comments by Director General Matt Brittin, who in July said one opportunity for Channel 4 would be “in partnership with the BBC, having content on iPlayer, but continuing to be ad-funded". The BBC's current funding model is based on a licence fee paid by TV-watching households. The proposal could also potentially enable the BBC to carry advertising around some of its own content, something barred under its current charter, the first person added. The government said last year that one option under consideration was to allow advertising around older BBC iPlayer content. The investment could be funded by the BBC's commercial arm, with the funds recovered over time through fees charged to third-party content providers, the first person said. An upgrade to iPlayer would also allow UKTV, the BBC-owned commercial broadcaster that operates advertising-funded channels such as U&Drama and U&Dave, to integrate content into the platform, the two people said. Other broadcasters, including ITV, could join in time, the second person added, potentially creating a shared platform for a wider range of British television content. The plan echoes Project Kangaroo, a proposed joint streaming venture between the BBC, ITV and Channel 4 that was blocked by UK regulators in 2009. Since then, streaming services and YouTube have taken a growing share of viewing.  SHARED PLATFORM FOR BRITISH BROADCASTERS The British government told Reuters it was aware that Channel 4 and the BBC were open to collaboration and partnership. "We continue to support and encourage all public service media providers to explore strategic partnerships where they benefit their audiences and the sustainability of the public service media ecosystem as a whole," a Department for Culture, Media and Sport spokesperson said. "The BBC must be funded by a model that is sustainable and fair. Through the BBC Charter Review, we are looking at a range of options, including how the licence fee could be reformed, but no final decisions have been made." A BBC spokesperson said: "As we have said before, we believe increased collaboration between all public service broadcasters is vital to ensure the industry thrives in a highly competitive global marketplace." Channel 4 Chief Executive Priya Dogra told lawmakers this month that the iPlayer idea was "worth exploring" but said that details needed to be worked out, including how advertising would work. British broadcasters are increasingly distributing their content through rival platforms to reach new audiences. Channel 4 will make some programmes available on Disney+ next year while the BBC is testing CBeebies children's programming content on Netflix. British media regulator Ofcom said in July that 26 per cent of UK viewers turned to Netflix first when deciding what to watch, compared with 25 per cent for the BBC. In its March submission to the BBC Charter Review, the BBC proposed exploring the integration of UKTV into iPlayer while keeping it distinct from BBC-branded content and services.

Source: Reuters

Israeli strike kills Hamas official, his wife and children

The airstrike that killed Mohammad Abuelouf, a Hamas colonel who heads the militants' interior security service, and his family was the second Israeli attack to kill a senior Hamas security official in the past 24 hours.

Palestinian child Mujahid Abuelouf carries the body of his father, Mohammad, during his funeral after he was killed in an Israeli airstrike, according to the Gaza Health Ministry, in Gaza City on Nov 25, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Mahmoud Issa)

FAST

CAIRO: Israel's military killed a senior Hamas security official as well as his wife and two children with an airstrike on their Gaza Strip apartment early on Wednesday (Nov 25), Gaza's Hamas-run interior ministry and medics said. The airstrike that killed Mohammad Abuelouf, a Hamas colonel who heads the militants' interior security service, and his family was the second Israeli attack to kill a senior Hamas security official in the past 24 hours. Despite a year-old ceasefire, Israel has continued to carry out attacks that it says target Hamas but have also killed many civilians. The broader ceasefire plan, backed by United States President Donald Trump, has failed to halt the violence or secure Hamas' disarmament. Medics said the airstrike ripped through Abuelouf's apartment early on Wednesday in the Beach refugee camp in western Gaza City, near the coast. Later in the morning, another Israeli airstrike hit Gaza City's northern Karama neighbourhood, killing one person, medics said.

Asked for comment, Israel's military said it "targeted several military operatives" in Gaza. It said it would issue further comment later. On Tuesday, after the military killed Naeem Abu Nahel, Hamas' head of internal security, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said there was no escape for Hamas from his country's "long reach". Hamas' internal security service, which Abu Nahel ran and in which Abuelouf was a senior official, counters Palestinians suspected of collaboration with Israel's secret service and gathers information about its plans. At least 1,600 Palestinians and five Israeli soldiers have been killed since the ceasefire was struck in October 2025, according to respective Palestinian and Israeli tallies. Israeli troops now control around two-thirds of Gaza, up from more than half at the time of the ceasefire, with Hamas controlling a sliver of territory along Gaza's coast. Israel's assault on Gaza has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians since 2023, caused a hunger crisis, internally displaced Gaza's entire population and led to assessments of genocide from scholars and United Nations inquiries. Israel has said its actions were in self-defence after Hamas-led militants killed 1,200 people and took more than 250 hostages in an attack on Israel in October 2023.

item.title: RBI net buyer of dollars for fourth straight month in September, data shows
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India recorded net purchases of $6.94 billion in the foreign exchange market during September. It bought a total of $82.18 billion while selling $75.25 billion in currency transactions. Despite a decline in the rupee, capital inflows reached about $143 billion due to various measures. Indian equities have recently attracted investors, leading to a rise in the rupee's value.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Reserve Bank of India was a net buyer in the foreign exchange market for the fourth consecutive month in September, reflecting likely interventions, swap maturities and absorption of capital inflows.The central bank bought a net $6.94 billion, with gross purchases of $82.18 billion and sales of $75.25 billion, according to data released on Wednesday in its monthly bulletin. It had purchased a net amount of $43.26 billion in August.The sustained buying comes as measures aimed at capital inflows drew about $143 billion, mostly from a zero-cost hedging facility for banks' overseas FX deposits. The inflows came despite the rupee slipping 0.7% in September on elevated crude prices and surging global bond yields.The bank's net outstanding forward dollar sales stood at nearly $240 billion as of end-September, compared with $200 billion at the end of August.The picture has shifted meaningfully since then, with Indian equities in November attracting investors fleeing AI-driven markets and oil prices dropping, accelerating a sharp reversal in the currency's fortunes.On Wednesday, the Indian rupee rose 0.73% against the US dollar to 92.23, climbing to its highest level so far this financial year.

AI stock rout deepens, with Anthropic hitting $74

A specialist trader works at his post on the floor at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York City, US, November 20, 2026. REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

FAST

Nov 25 : AI-linked stocks were hammered for a second straight day on Wednesday, with investor concern about rising costs and forbidding debt dynamics sending the shares of many of the industry's largest players tumbling to fresh 52-week lows. AI lab Anthropic traded as low as $73.85 shortly after the open, putting it 11 per cent below its initial offering price last week. Alphabet dropped 4.7 per cent and hit a 52-week low that was some 35 per cent below its level at midyear. Chip giant Broadcom, one of the leaders of an epic midyear semiconductor rally, dropped 5.8 per cent and hit a 52-week low that left it 41 per cent below its high for 2026. The rout partly reflected the unwind of earlier optimism in the AI sector, driven in part by Democratic wins in US midterm elections that promise greater regulation and a slower, costlier AI buildout. Sentiment was further impaired on Wednesday by the Trump administration's proposed new tariffs on imports from 14 trading partners and data showing US inflation increased further in October. But the selling, which began soon after the Nasdaq composite's record high on October 6 and increased markedly in the second half of November, also underscored gathering concern about the financial underpinnings of an infrastructure expansion that has increasingly been financed by large sales of debt — a practice that tends to make markets more fragile and vulnerable to reversal.

Overnight in Tokyo, OpenAI shareholder SoftBank fell 14 per cent, underscoring fears that ChatGPT maker OpenAI may face increasing resistance as it seeks to raise money. SoftBank, also a major investor in chip firm Arm, is down more than 40 per cent for the year. Nvidia, a major OpenAI partner in data centers and other aspects of the AI ecosystem, dropped 8.5 per cent to a fresh low. The so-called neocloud firms that back AI data center capacity were under renewed attack, reflecting in part concern about their capacity to raise funds to support ambitious building plans. "It seems that these companies are trying to one-up each other on the amount of money that they're spending, but you have to show that it's worth it, and that's where Wall Street is saying 'I don't know'," said Todd Schoenberger, chief investment officer at CrossCheck Management. HEADING INTO BEAR TERRITORY The Nasdaq-100 was down 4 per cent by mid-morning. The index briefly fell 20 per cent below its October 6 record closing high, a level that would confirm a bear market if it held through Wednesday's close. The worries about the underpinnings of the AI boom were so significant that even firms reporting strong results were caught in the downdraft, reflecting in part their large stock-price gains earlier in the year. Dell Technologies fell 5.7 per cent on Wednesday despite the server maker raising its annual revenue and profit forecasts for the third time this year and approving an additional $25 billion share buyback. Dell stock has more than doubled for the year. Rival AI server maker HPE tumbled 16.3 per cent on Tuesday after raising its full-year revenue outlook. Shares of Ambarella, valued at $2 billion, tumbled 20.9 per cent after the AI semiconductor firm forecast fourth-quarter revenue below analysts' estimates. The Philadelphia chips index slid 7 per cent to hit a more than seven-month low. The index has plunged more than 43 per cent from its record high in June. Shares of AI hyperscalers were broadly lower, with Oracle down 8 per cent and Amazon.com off 6 per cent. Nvidia-backed neocloud firms CoreWeave and Nebius Group fell more than 10 per cent each, while IREN, Applied Digital and Core Scientific lost between 6.9 per cent and 10.8 per cent. Neocloud providers, which rent out specialized AI computing capacity, have been under pressure since October over concerns about the debt funding their rapid expansion. The yield on CoreWeave's bonds due 2031 rose to almost 18 per cent as prices fell nearly 2 cents on the dollar to near record lows, Tradeweb data showed. The cost of insurance against tech companies defaulting on debts has jumped sharply, with five-year CDS spreads at Oracle, Alphabet, SpaceX and CoreWeave hitting record levels.

Source: Reuters

item.title: US military pause clouds Ecuador’s illegal mining fight
item.description: A Pentagon probe raises uncertainty over efforts to combat criminal gangs that have infiltrated Ecuador’s gold supply chain.
item.dc:creator: Cecilia Jamasmie
item.content:encoded:
US military pause clouds Ecuador’s illegal mining fight A Pentagon probe raises uncertainty over efforts to combat criminal gangs that have infiltrated Ecuador’s gold supply chain.

Cecilia Jamasmie | November 25, 2026 - 6:37 am

Categories: Copper Gold Regulatory Issues South America United States

Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa meets US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth. ( Image courtesy of Hegseth | X. )

Ecuador’s Interior Minister John Reimberg reaffirmed the country’s security partnership with Washington following reports that the Trump administration had suspended joint military operations, raising uncertainty over efforts to combat drug trafficking and illegal mining.

Talks last week with US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth focused on reviewing operations, determining next steps and identifying Ecuador’s operational needs, Reimberg said in a radio interview Wednesday, Reuters reported. He described the discussions as productive, pointing to an established action plan between the two countries.

“Some would like to see these relationships, which have yielded so many positive results, damaged,” Reimberg said.

The remarks follow reports Tuesday by The New York Times and The Atlantic that Washington halted joint operations in mid-October. The US Department of Defense reportedly launched an investigation into alleged human rights violations during a Sept. 23 operation by Ecuadorian forces in Manabí province that killed a suspected criminal leader.

The reported suspension comes at a critical juncture for Ecuador, which in July elevated illegal mining to a national security threat after concluding that criminal gangs had infiltrated the country’s gold supply chain, turning the sector into a major source of financing for organized crime.

Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa and Hegseth discussed expanding technological assistance, port security and border surveillance during last week’s visit. However, no new agreement was signed amid domestic political sensitivities ahead of the Nov. 29 local elections.

Noboa announced in March that Ecuador would conduct joint operations with the US and other allies, describing the initiative as “a new phase” in the fight against narco-terrorism and illegal mining. While the initiative has garnered public support, Ecuadorians voted last year against allowing foreign military bases on national territory.

Criminal gold

Ecuador’s 2026–2029 National Security Plan identifies illegal mining as a strategic security challenge rather than simply an environmental or regulatory issue.

The government says criminal organizations use illicit gold production to launder drug trafficking proceeds while supplying mining operations with machinery, chemicals and armed protection.

Gangs hijack Ecuador’s gold mining supply chain

The strategy reflects growing concern over the profitability of illicit gold production, which is fuelling violence and environmental destruction while exposing vulnerabilities in Ecuador’s mineral supply chain.

The plan identifies Los Lobos as the country’s dominant criminal organization in illegal mining. A report by the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) similarly concludes that the gang operates across the gold value chain, from extraction to exports through the ports of Guayaquil and Puerto Bolívar.

Regional resistance

The Trump administration’s push to expand military co-operation under its American Coalition Against the Cartels faces political obstacles elsewhere in Latin America, where governments must balance security priorities with concerns over sovereignty and the legacy of US military interventions.

During Hegseth’s recent trip, Colombian President Abelardo De La Espriella told Washington he lacked congressional support to authorize joint military operations, The New York Times reported.

Nearly 70% of Ecuador’s protected areas are located in the Napo province, where most illegal miners are active.

De La Espriella denied the report , while Hegseth said on X that the alliance between the two countries was “stronger than ever.”

Adam Isacson, a security expert at the Washington Office on Latin America, said the suspension in Ecuador and the lukewarm reception Hegseth received from right-wing governments suggested the Trump administration’s strategy of conducting joint strikes across the region was “losing momentum.”

The Pentagon maintained in a statement to the NYT that US military officers remained “committed to working alongside sovereign partners, including Ecuador, to confront narco-terrorist networks.”

(With files from Reuters)

FAST

WASHINGTON: United States President Donald Trump on Wednesday (Nov 25) fired a new tariff salvo on 14 major trading partners, including China, Japan, the European Union and Singapore, undeterred in his protectionist push by the losses his Republican Party suffered in US midterm elections . His administration proposed new headline tariff rates of 20 per cent to 40 per cent, but said duties would be capped at lower levels agreed under trade deals that have already been concluded or remain under negotiation. Under the main "Section 301" probe into excess industrial capacity, China would face the highest capped rate of 20 per cent, which would be added to duties of roughly 25 per cent imposed during Trump's first term. That rate would comply with a US-China trade truce that expires on January 10. But if the truce unravels, China's rate would rise to 40%, the United States Trade Representative (USTR) said.

Vietnam would face a capped tariff rate of 20 per cent if it reaches a trade agreement with Washington, rising to 35 per cent if negotiations fail. US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said the tariffs, which would not take effect until after a Jan 25 public hearing, were intended to counteract "industrial strategies built on targeting manufacturing, wage and labour suppression, financial and other support, non-market economy inputs, and other market-distorting practices" that undermine the US manufacturing base. Washington has long accused China of subsidising industry and flooding global markets with low-cost exports ranging from steel to electric vehicles and solar products. Beijing earlier reiterated its opposition to "trade wars" and rejected allegations of overcapacity, but stopped short of threatening retaliation. "FALSE ISSUE", CHINA SAYS "The so-called 'overcapacity' is a false issue, and China opposes using it as an excuse for political manipulation," Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said, urging the world's top two economies to maintain stable relations. The USTR also proposed capped tariff rates of 18 per cent for imported goods from Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Bangladesh, and 15 per cent, including existing "Most Favored Nation" duties, for Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, the EU and Switzerland. India, which has yet to reach a trade deal with the Trump administration, would face a 17 per cent tariff rate if an agreement is finalised and a 25 per cent rate if talks fail, the USTR said. Singapore would receive a capped tariff rate of 10 per cent. Greer told CNBC the proposed caps were consistent with trade agreements reached over the past year that also lowered barriers to US exports. "We're sticking to that in terms of our proposals because we think a lot of these deals we made actually solve a lot of the problems we see in excess capacity or can go toward it," Greer said. "So you know we've talked to our trading partners about this. They know what we're proposing. I think a lot of this is baked in." Mexico and Norway were excluded from the proposals because investigations into their trade practices remain under way, Greer said. Even so, the prospect of new trade barriers weighed on stock markets on Wednesday amid a renewed sell-off in tech stocks. Major US indexes opened down more than 1 per cent, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq composite down more than 3 per cent. "It is another reminder that while the legal justification for tariffs keeps changing, US protectionism is becoming increasingly difficult to unwind," ING analysts wrote. Separately, the USTR proposed a new 10 per cent tariff on imports of Brazil's finished Embraer commercial aircraft, and to raise duties on imports of Brazilian sugar that exceed quotas as part of an effort to push Brasilia to rectify alleged unfair trade practices. The products were previously exempted from Trump's 25 per cent tariffs on Brazilian goods that were imposed in July. A US official said that despite negotiations, there were "substantial differences" over the allegations.

Related:

China warns US against imposing new tariffs

Courtesy for courtesy, curbs for curbs? The two sides of Trump-Xi reciprocity

NEW DUTIES WON'T EXCEED NEGOTIATED LIMITS Trump's tariffs have contributed to higher prices for US consumers, and a Reuters-Ipsos opinion poll conducted after Republicans' midterm losses found 62 per cent of respondents supported efforts to repeal them. But Trump has long vowed to restore duties struck down by the US Supreme Court in February. The latest measures follow an eight-month investigation into unfair trade practices under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974. Greer said the proposed tariffs would not apply to about US$30 billion of Chinese imports under consideration for tariff reductions through a bilateral mechanism known as the Board of Trade. However, the new duties would be added to tariffs imposed on Chinese goods during Trump's first term, which total roughly 25 per cent. They would not be imposed on top of the 10 per cent and 12.5 per cent tariffs introduced in July on a broader group of 60 trading partners over allegations of lax enforcement of anti-forced-labour laws. Analysts said higher US trade barriers against China and other economies are the direction of travel, even if the Democratic Party - which won majorities in both houses of Congress earlier this month - tried to curb Trump's tariff impulses. "Without the two-thirds majority needed to override a presidential veto, Democrats' ability to dismantle the tariff wall will remain limited," ING analysts said in a note. "Either way, we don't think the blue wave will mark a return to free trade. The Biden years already showed that tariffs in strategically important sectors enjoy support across political camps." The US-China truce runs until Jan 10, but many expect it to be extended - potentially as early as next month when Trump and Xi are set to meet again at a Group of Twenty gathering in Miami - given the major impact a re-escalation of tit-for-tat hikes similar to those seen in 2025 would have on both economies. The USTR's investigation is also partly directed at Chinese investment in Southeast Asian countries, including Vietnam, Indonesia and Cambodia, to manufacture goods for the US market and avoid prior US tariffs.

item.title: Zepbound, Ozempic to Come With New FDA Warning Label During Patient Lawsuits

item.title: ＥＵ、500億ユーロ規模の株式ファンド計画 量子技術振興へ
item.description:
Foo Yun Chee Charlotte Van Campenhout
[ブリュッセル ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Foo Yun Chee　Charlotte Van Campenhout

[ブリュッセル ２５日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）欧州委員会は２５日、２０３０年までに欧州を量子技術の世界的リーダーとするため、５００億ユーロ（５４７億３０００万ドル）規模の株式ファンドの設立に加え、調達入札において欧州企業を優遇するその他措置を提案した。

「量子法案」は、ＡＩ（人工知能）開発、半導体、クラウドコンピューティングの分野で米国や中国に後れを取っている欧州が、第三国への依存度を低減できるよう支援することを目的としている。

また、米国企業が「キルスイッチ」を使用して欧州での自社製品の機能を遮断する可能性があることへの懸念が高まっている中、ＥＵは現地での製品・サービスの開発に注力している。

ビルクネン欧州委員（技術担当）は「量子技術は産業、安全保障、イノベーションの未来を形作り、われわれの社会に多大な影響を与えるだろう。欧州は今、その取り組みを加速させる必要がある」と声明で述べた。

この法案は、法律として成立する前に、今後数カ月の間にＥＵ加盟国および欧州議会との間で調整を行う必要がある。

欧州委によると、世界の量子関連企業の約３分の１がＥＵに拠点を置いている。昨年の量子技術への公的資金は８６億ユーロに達したが、米国は５３億ユーロ、中国は１３６億ユーロだった。

しかし、量子スタートアップに対する欧州の民間資金は１１億ユーロにとどまり、米国の７０億ユーロには及ばなかった。

法案は「量子技術が安全保障やＥＵの戦略的利益、技術的自立に及ぼしうる影響を考慮すると、調達手続きを、ＥＵの管理下にある事業体が提供する製品、システム、サービスに限定する必要がある」と述べている。

また、ＥＵが相互パートナーシップを結んでいる第三国の事業体も、入札に参加できるとしている。
